families.name: Wood & Root
families.description: Cedar, sandalwood, vetiver and patchouli: grounded, dry and structural.

families.name: White Bloom
families.description: Jasmine, tuberose, gardenia and orange blossom: luminous white florals.

families.name: Petal Garden
families.description: Rose, peony, iris and violet: the soft, romantic heart of perfumery.

families.name: Green Leaf
families.description: Galbanum, violet leaf, moss and herbs: cut stems and cool shade.

families.name: Velvet Sweet
families.description: Vanilla, tonka, caramel and cocoa: plush, edible warmth.

families.name: Sunlit Citrus
families.description: Bergamot, lemon, mandarin and neroli: bright, clean and immediately alive.

families.name: Spice Route
families.description: Pepper, cardamom, cinnamon and saffron: heat, texture and motion.

families.name: Orchard Fruit
families.description: Pear, peach, plum and berries: juicy, ripe and playful.

families.name: Amber & Resin
families.description: Labdanum, benzoin, myrrh and incense: golden, balmy depth.

families.name: Powder Veil
families.description: Iris, heliotrope and soft musk: a hazy, skin-close finish.

families.name: Skin Musk
families.description: Musk, ambrette and cashmeran: warm skin, clean laundry, quiet intimacy.

families.name: Smoke & Leather
families.description: Birch, tobacco, suede and incense smoke: dark, tailored and animalic.

families.name: Salt & Mineral
families.description: Sea air, salt, driftwood and mineral accord: open, weightless freshness.

families.name: Oud Court
families.description: Oud, agarwood and cypriol: resinous, regal and unmistakably deep.

clusters.name: Wood & Root · Oud & Patchouli
clusters.description: A wood & root-led cluster with amber & resin undertones. Built around Oud, Patchouli, Musk.

clusters.name: Petal Garden · Musk & Rose
clusters.description: A petal garden-led cluster with wood & root undertones. Built around Musk, Rose, Bergamot.

clusters.name: White Bloom · Jasmine & Vanilla
clusters.description: A white bloom-led cluster with wood & root undertones. Built around Jasmine, Vanilla, Musk.

clusters.name: Amber & Resin · Leather & Patchouli
clusters.description: A amber & resin-led cluster with wood & root undertones. Built around Leather, Patchouli, Vanilla.

clusters.name: Velvet Sweet · Vanilla & Tonka Bean
clusters.description: A velvet sweet-led cluster with amber & resin undertones. Built around Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk.

clusters.name: Wood & Root · Bergamot & Cedarwood
clusters.description: A wood & root-led cluster with green leaf undertones. Built around Bergamot, Cedarwood, Patchouli.

perfumes.name: Libre
perfumes.description: Mandarin and neroli brighten a creamy bloom of orange blossom and jasmine sambac, settling into a quiet base of musk and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Shalimar
perfumes.description: Floral notes and a flash of bergamot sit above iris, jasmine and rose, giving way to a dense, sweet base of vanilla, tonka bean and opoponax.

perfumes.name: Oud Wood
perfumes.description: Smooth woods and spice: cardamom and pink pepper open into patchouli, amber and oud, warmed by tonka bean.

perfumes.name: Aventus
perfumes.description: Sparkling lemon and blackcurrant open onto pineapple and jasmine, while birch and oakmoss give the base a smoky, earthy edge.

perfumes.name: Baccarat Rouge 540
perfumes.description: Jasmine and saffron open airy and golden, held together by cedarwood and an ambergris accord.

perfumes.name: Santal 33
perfumes.description: Australian sandalwood and cedarwood are spiced with cardamom and powdered by iris and violet, with papyrus giving a dry edge.

perfumes.name: Gypsy Water
perfumes.description: Woody and aromatic: bergamot, juniper, lemon and pepper, then incense, orris and pine needle over amber, sandalwood and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Layton
perfumes.description: An apple-and-lavender blend: bergamot and cardamom up top, violet and geranium in the middle, patchouli, vanilla and praline below.

perfumes.name: J'adore
perfumes.description: Ylang ylang, Damascus rose and jasmine form a rounded, creamy floral bouquet with a smooth finish.

perfumes.name: Oud for Greatness
perfumes.description: A dark, spiced oud: agarwood oil and oud with lavender, saffron, nutmeg and patchouli, softened by musk.

perfumes.name: Angels' Share
perfumes.description: Cognac and oak give a boozy opening, followed by cinnamon and a sweet, nutty base of tonka bean, sandalwood and praline.

perfumes.name: Black Opium
perfumes.description: Coffee and white flowers are drawn together by a soft, sweet vanilla.

perfumes.name: Mitsouko
perfumes.description: Citrus and jasmine turn to peach, ylang-ylang and rose, then spices, amber and cinnamon settle over vetiver and mossy oakmoss.

perfumes.name: Portrait of a Lady
perfumes.description: A lavish rose enriched with blackcurrant, raspberry and clove, then deepened by patchouli and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Tobacco Vanille
perfumes.description: Rich and sweet: tobacco leaf and ginger with spice, tonka and cocoa, plus a dried-fruit accord.

perfumes.name: Silver Mountain Water
perfumes.description: Neroli and mandarin sparkle above cool green tea and blackcurrant bud, with a sea-air freshness and a smooth finish of sandalwood and musk.

perfumes.name: English Pear & Freesia
perfumes.description: Ripe pear leads to a delicate freesia heart, grounded by patchouli. Light, juicy and quietly earthy.

perfumes.name: Aqua Universalis
perfumes.description: Lemon and bergamot are bright and clean, set against a soft floral heart. A veil of musk makes the whole composition feel fresh and airy.

perfumes.name: Another 13
perfumes.description: Ambroxan and ambrette seeds create a skin-like glow, with jasmine and moss adding an earthy, floral edge.

perfumes.name: Acqua di Giò
perfumes.description: Marine freshness meets green mandarin and a leaf of sage, keeping the whole composition bright, herbal and lightly salted.

perfumes.name: Bal d'Afrique
perfumes.description: Fresh and floral-woody: buchu, marigold, bergamot and blackcurrant, then cyclamen, jasmine and violet, over tonka, cedarwood, musks and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Delina
perfumes.description: A rosy, fruity-floral built on lychee and rhubarb over damascena rose, resting on soft musks, cashmeran and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Paradoxe
perfumes.description: Neroli bud adds a green floral lift above a smooth, glowing mix of white amber and white musk.

perfumes.name: Side Effect
perfumes.description: A warm, boozy spice blend of cinnamon, rum, tobacco and saffron on sandalwood, with hedione adding a smooth, airy touch.

perfumes.name: Love, Don't Be Shy
perfumes.description: Neroli opens gently before rose and honeysuckle, leaving a sweet, warm trail of marshmallow and labdanum. Soft, creamy and floral.

perfumes.name: Reflection Man
perfumes.description: An elegant, herbal-floral classic: rosemary and petitgrain open to neroli, iris and jasmine, resting on vetiver, patchouli and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: L'Heure Bleue
perfumes.description: An airy ozonic note leads into powdery iris and soft vanilla, giving a hushed, dusky character.

perfumes.name: Angel
perfumes.description: Sweet praline and earthy patchouli sit under a bright flash of bergamot, giving a gourmand scent with a surprisingly fresh lift.

perfumes.name: Musc Ravageur
perfumes.description: A sensual, floral-free amber: bergamot, mandarin and lavender at the start, then a warm, musky heart of amber and vanilla that rests on sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Black Orchid
perfumes.description: A dark, truffled floral: black truffle and ylang ylang with orchid and plum, deepened by rum and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Flowerbomb
perfumes.description: A floral bouquet that opens with peony, moves to centifolia rose and settles on freesia and vanilla. Soft, sweet and ambery.

perfumes.name: Green Irish Tweed
perfumes.description: Lemon, verbena and galbanum give a cool green opening, with lavender and violet in the middle. Sandalwood and cedarwood settle into a fresh, mossy woodiness.

perfumes.name: Wood Sage & Sea Salt
perfumes.description: Ambrette, salt and sage create a breezy, mineral calm. Herbal and musky, with the feel of a cool coastal walk.

perfumes.name: Grand Soir
perfumes.description: Deep and glowing, an amber built from cistus labdanum, benzoin and vanilla, resinous and sweet.

perfumes.name: Twilly d'Hermès
perfumes.description: Spicy ginger brightens a creamy tuberose heart, while sandalwood gives the whole a smooth, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Mojave Ghost
perfumes.description: Soft and musky: ambrette and naseberry open to magnolia, sandalwood and violet, finishing on cedarwood, musks and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Vanilla 28
perfumes.description: Vanilla orchid and brown sugar lead a deep, sweet blend with tonka absolute, amber woods and a soft layer of musk.

perfumes.name: Replica By the Fireplace
perfumes.description: A cosy, smoky winter scent. Pink pepper, orange flower and clove lead to chestnut, guaiac wood and cade, ending on vanilla, Peru balsam and cashmeran. Warm and sweet.

perfumes.name: Pegasus
perfumes.description: Soft and almondy: anise, bergamot and almond open to cypress, violet leaves and orange blossom, drying down to vanilla, sandalwood and ambrox.

perfumes.name: L'Homme Prada
perfumes.description: Powdery iris and neroli lend a creamy, floral softness, touched by the green freshness of geranium.

perfumes.name: Arabians Tonka
perfumes.description: Saffron and bergamot lead into rose and oud, settling on amber, tonka bean, leather and brown sugar. A sweet, smoky and warm oriental built on a soft musk base.

perfumes.name: Dylan Blue
perfumes.description: Bergamot, grapefruit and fig meet an aquatic accord, with pepper and violet leaf in the middle. Patchouli, musk, tonka bean and incense give a warm, spiced base.

perfumes.name: Atomic Rose
perfumes.description: A rich rose-and-vanilla scent: bergamot brightens Turkish and Bulgarian rose with jasmine, and hedione adds a luminous, airy shimmer.

perfumes.name: Cedrat Boise
perfumes.description: A fresh citrus-woody scent built on citrus and blackcurrant with cold spices, aquatic jasmine and patchouli leaves, drying down to leather, oakmoss and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Donna Born in Roma
perfumes.description: Jasmine sambac and vanilla are rounded by cashmeran, giving a sweet, creamy floral with a smooth woody backdrop.

perfumes.name: Good Girl Gone Bad
perfumes.description: A creamy floral built on orange blossom, rose, osmanthus and tuberose, with daffodil giving the base a soft, green finish.

perfumes.name: Idôle
perfumes.description: Bergamot, juicy pear and pink peppercorn open onto rose and jasmine, ending in white musk, vanilla, patchouli and cedarwood.

perfumes.name: Hacivat
perfumes.description: A citrus-chypre scent: bergamot, pineapple and grapefruit give a juicy opening, jasmine, patchouli and cedarwood form the heart, and clearwood, oakmoss and dry timberwood anchor it.

perfumes.name: La Nuit de L'Homme
perfumes.description: Anise, black pepper and bergamot lead to lavender and labdanum, finishing on vanilla, patchouli and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Jicky
perfumes.description: Fresh herbs open the scent, with bergamot, lavender and rosemary, and over time tonka bean, vanilla and opoponax add a sweet, warm depth.

perfumes.name: Alien
perfumes.description: Jasmine sambac turns creamy and radiant here, resting on a woody cashmeran core and a soft amber glow that lingers close to the skin.

perfumes.name: Kirke
perfumes.description: A sweet, fruity scent: passion fruit, peach, raspberry, blackcurrant and pear over lily of the valley, resting on heliotrope, sandalwood, vanilla, patchouli and musk.

perfumes.name: Carnal Flower
perfumes.description: Melon and bergamot freshen a heavy, creamy heart of tuberose and jasmine, finished with a soft layer of musk.

perfumes.name: Khamrah
perfumes.description: A dessert-like spiced gourmand: cinnamon, nutmeg and bergamot lead into dates, praline and tuberose, then a long vanilla, tonka, myrrh and benzoin base.

perfumes.name: Lost Cherry
perfumes.description: A boozy cherry gourmand: black cherry and cherry syrup with bitter almond, rose, balsam and roasted tonka.

perfumes.name: Club de Nuit Intense Man
perfumes.description: A fresh fruity opening of apple, bergamot and blackcurrant leads to rose, birch and jasmine, with a smoky-musky base of ambergris and patchouli.

perfumes.name: 212 VIP
perfumes.description: Passion fruit and bergamot sparkle over gardenia and a boozy hint of rum, leaving benzoin and musk to warm the base.

perfumes.name: Viking
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, bergamot and lemon open sharply, then rose and spicy mint lead toward a deep base of sandalwood, vetiver, patchouli and lavandin.

perfumes.name: 9 PM Night Out
perfumes.description: A sweet, warm evening scent: dragon fruit, bergamot and cognac up front, cardamom, suede and toffee in the middle, then tonka, patchouli and woody-amber materials at the finish.

perfumes.name: Peony & Blush Suede
perfumes.description: Crisp apple and soft peony sit over a suede base. Fruity and floral, with a faint, smooth, soft-edged finish.

perfumes.name: Oud Satin Mood
perfumes.description: Violet and two kinds of rose open a velvety floral that settles on natural oud, benzoin, vanilla and amber.

perfumes.name: Gentleman
perfumes.description: Pepper and lavender open into powdery iris and resinous balsam of Peru, with patchouli and vanilla keeping the base warm.

perfumes.name: Un Jardin sur le Nil
perfumes.description: Green mango and lotus blossom bring a juicy, watery brightness, softened by smoky incense and sycamore wood.

perfumes.name: Armani Code
perfumes.description: Clean citrus from mandarin and bergamot meets a herbal edge of tarragon, keeping the mood cool and composed.

perfumes.name: Blanche
perfumes.description: A clean, soft floral: aldehydes and rose open to peony and violet, with musks and sandalwood underneath.

perfumes.name: Nomade
perfumes.description: A gentle fruit and flower composition: plum, freesia and a mossy, earthy base of oakmoss.

perfumes.name: Bloom
perfumes.description: Creamy and floral throughout, built around Rangoon creeper, tuberose and jasmine in a slow, rounded progression.

perfumes.name: Herod
perfumes.description: A smooth tobacco gourmand: cinnamon and pepper meet tobacco leaf, incense and osmanthus, softened by vanilla, musks and cedarwood.

perfumes.name: Luna Rossa Carbon
perfumes.description: Lavender and cypress keep it cool and green, with liquorice adding a faint, sweet edge.

perfumes.name: Intense Cafe
perfumes.description: Rose and coffee form the heart of this warm gourmand, framed by a floral opening. Amber, vanilla and white musk give it a creamy, roasted-sweet base.

perfumes.name: Absolute Aphrodisiac
perfumes.description: A warm, animalic floral: white flowers over amber, vanilla and musk, with a castoreum edge that adds a leathery, skin-like depth.

perfumes.name: Uomo Born in Roma Intense
perfumes.description: Vanilla is sharpened by lavandin and anchored in earthy vetiver, sweet yet herbal and dry.

perfumes.name: Her
perfumes.description: Dark berries of blackcurrant, blueberry and raspberry lead into violet and jasmine, then dry to powdery white woods, musk and amber.

perfumes.name: Ani
perfumes.description: Bergamot, blue ginger and pink pepper open into blackcurrant, Turkish rose and cardamom. A vanilla-led base of benzoin, ambergris, patchouli and sandalwood makes it warm, spicy and creamy.

perfumes.name: Mon Paris
perfumes.description: Juicy strawberry and pear lead into peony and orange blossom, then dry down to soft musk, patchouli and vanilla. Fruity, floral and creamy.

perfumes.name: Lipstick Rose
perfumes.description: Rose and iris in a powdery veil, with grapefruit and violet on top and raspberry adding a little fruit. Vanilla and musk soften the finish.

perfumes.name: Yara
perfumes.description: Soft, sweet and fruity-floral: orchid, heliotrope and tangerine up top, a creamy gourmand and tropical fruit heart, then vanilla, musk and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Soleil Blanc
perfumes.description: A creamy, sun-warmed floral: bergamot and cardamom with pistachio, ylang ylang and benzoin, rounded by a coconut-like accord.

perfumes.name: Bonbon
perfumes.description: A sweet gourmand fragrance: mandarin at the top, orange blossom in the middle and a soft caramel base. Fruity and creamy, with a candy-like character.

perfumes.name: Tam Dao
perfumes.description: Rose, myrtle and cypress open green and fresh before creamy sandalwood and cedar, with rosewood, amber and white musk adding a gentle warmth.

perfumes.name: Gentle Fluidity Gold
perfumes.description: Juniper berries and nutmeg open dry and spicy, then coriander turns to a warm base of vanilla, musk and ambery woods.

perfumes.name: L'Interdit
perfumes.description: Orange blossom opens into creamy jasmine and tuberose, while vetiver and patchouli give the white flowers an earthy, shadowed edge. Rich, smooth and slightly dark.

perfumes.name: Eau des Merveilles
perfumes.description: Elemi and bitter orange give a bright, slightly salty start, and benzoin brings a warm, resinous sweetness.

perfumes.name: Scandal
perfumes.description: Honey and gardenia lend a rich, sweet floral tone, brightened by blood orange and grounded by an earthy patchouli.

perfumes.name: Thé Noir 29
perfumes.description: Fig and bay leaves add a green, fruity thread to black tea and bergamot, with cedarwood, vetiver and musk beneath.

perfumes.name: Rose of No Man's Land
perfumes.description: A dry, spicy rose: pink pepper and Turkish rose with raspberry blossom, settling into amber and papyrus.

perfumes.name: Guilty
perfumes.description: Mandora and pink pepper start bright and spiced, a lilac heart follows, and an earthy base of patchouli closes the scent.

perfumes.name: Replica Lazy Sunday Morning
perfumes.description: A soft linen-fresh floral. Pear, lily of the valley and aldehydes open, iris, rose and orange flower follow, and patchouli, ambrette seeds and white musks keep it clean and quiet.

perfumes.name: Galloway
perfumes.description: Fresh and peppery: lemon and elemi lead into cardamom and iris, then dry down to clean musks, ambrox and smoky cypriol.

perfumes.name: Luna Rossa Ocean
perfumes.description: Grapefruit brings a sharp citrus lift, then incense and vanilla follow in a warm, resinous and slightly sweet drydown.

perfumes.name: Aqva Pour Homme
perfumes.description: Mandarin brings a bright citrus lift to a green, herbal heart of santolina, finishing on clary sage.

perfumes.name: Boss Bottled
perfumes.description: Apple, bergamot and pepper meet cinnamon, nutmeg and cardamom, a warm, spiced progression that rests on vetiver and musk.

perfumes.name: Black Aoud
perfumes.description: A dark oud perfume lifted by lemon, mandarin and saffron, with rose and patchouli at the centre and leather, guaiac wood and sandalwood underneath. Smoky, spicy and bold.

perfumes.name: Pour Homme
perfumes.description: Citron, bergamot and neroli open bright, followed by geranium, clary sage and blue hyacinth, then cedar wood, mineral amber, tonka beans and musk.

perfumes.name: Poison
perfumes.description: Coriander flickers at the start, then a heavy tuberose heart sinks into a warm, resinous trail of opoponax.

perfumes.name: Rehab
perfumes.description: A fresh, clean aromatic woody: bergamot and lavender over cedarwood, patchouli and sandalwood, finished with hedione and musk.

perfumes.name: Red Tobacco
perfumes.description: A heavy, spicy tobacco scent: saffron, cinnamon, incense, nutmeg, peach, apple and oud open, with patchouli and jasmine beneath tobacco, amber, vetiver, vanilla and musk.

perfumes.name: Explorer
perfumes.description: A woody, leathery men's fragrance that opens with bergamot, pomarose and sage, moves through vetiver and leather, and settles into patchouli and ambery woods.

perfumes.name: Voce Viva
perfumes.description: Bergamot and orange blossom rise over vanilla, with crystal moss adding a cool, earthy edge to the sweetness.

perfumes.name: Fan Your Flames
perfumes.description: Coconut and rum open a short but rich pyramid, moving to tobacco and tonka bean before oakmoss and Chinese cedarwood. Boozy, sweet and smoky.

perfumes.name: Gold Man
perfumes.description: A classic rose-and-lily opening with jasmine, orris and myrrh in the heart, over an animalic, mossy base of ambergris, civet, sandalwood and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Polo Blue
perfumes.description: Bergamot, sea notes and cardamom feel airy and fresh, with iris and basil verbena in the middle and earthy vetiver and patchouli below.

perfumes.name: Orion
perfumes.description: A fresh fruity opening of bergamot, red currant, apple and pineapple leads into spice, birch and jasmine, then incense, amber, oud, musk and cedar.

perfumes.name: Dans tes Bras
perfumes.description: Violet drifts into a smooth, powdery heart of heliotrope and cashmeran, resting on sandalwood and clean white musk.

perfumes.name: Asad
perfumes.description: A dark, warm amber for men: black pepper, pineapple and tobacco on top, patchouli, coffee and iris in the middle, and vanilla, benzoin and labdanum below.

perfumes.name: Neroli Portofino
perfumes.description: Citrus, lavender and herbs form a bright coastal opening. Orange blossom, jasmine and neroli follow, ending in soft amber and ambrette. Creamy, floral and fresh.

perfumes.name: Club de Nuit Milestone
perfumes.description: A fresh, marine-leaning scent for men: bergamot, red fruits and sea tones, then violet and sandalwood, ending on vetiver, musk and ambroxan.

perfumes.name: CH
perfumes.description: Bergamot and grapefruit brighten a heart of rose and jasmine sambac. Patchouli and praline underneath add a gentle, sweet depth to the flowers.

perfumes.name: Himalaya
perfumes.description: Sandalwood, ambergris, cedarwood and musk warm a start of bergamot, grapefruit and lemon.

perfumes.name: L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme
perfumes.description: Yuzu sparkles first, then cinnamon and nutmeg add warmth before a quiet base of sandalwood.

perfumes.name: 9 PM Elixir
perfumes.description: Nutmeg and cardamom warm the opening before lavandin and leather take over, closing in a resinous, softly sweet base of labdanum, patchouli and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Kenzo Homme
perfumes.description: A marine accord drifts over smoky leather and patchouli, creating a salty, earthy contrast.

perfumes.name: Gentle Fluidity Silver
perfumes.description: Juniper and coriander give a crisp, aromatic start, while nutmeg and a soft vanilla musk bring a rounded, woody warmth.

perfumes.name: Toy Boy
perfumes.description: A spicy-floral scent with bergamot, pink berries, elemi and nutmeg on top, rose, flax flower and magnolia in the heart, and a dry vetiver and ambery base.

perfumes.name: Olympéa
perfumes.description: Green mandarin, ginger lily and jasmine over a salty vanilla, with cashmere wood and ambergris giving a smooth, skin-warm base.

perfumes.name: L'Air du Temps
perfumes.description: Carnation and gardenia open creamy and spiced, with rose and jasmine at the heart. Sandalwood and iris end powdery and woody.

perfumes.name: Super Cedar
perfumes.description: Rose petals open softly before a long stretch of cedarwood, which fades into silky musk and earthy Haitian vetiver.

perfumes.name: Utopia Vanilla Coco 21
perfumes.description: Honeysuckle, pear blossom, lemon and coconut open into jasmine, gardenia and tuberose, drying to sandalwood, Bourbon vanilla, patchouli and soft musks.

perfumes.name: Paradiso
perfumes.description: Citrus, mandarin and bergamot are bright, with jasmine at the heart. Pine, cypress and laurel leaf give a green, resinous base.

perfumes.name: Cool Water Woman
perfumes.description: Pineapple, lemon, melon and blackcurrant are watery and juicy, with lily and jasmine in the heart. Musk, sandalwood, peach and vanilla soften the base.

perfumes.name: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia
perfumes.description: Juicy pear sits on creamy white gardenia, with brown sugar adding a sweet, soft glow.

perfumes.name: Replica Beach Walk
perfumes.description: A sunny beach scent: bergamot, pink pepper and lemon, then ylang ylang, heliotrope and coconut milk, over cedarwood, white musks and benzoin. Fresh, creamy and sun-warmed.

perfumes.name: Percival
perfumes.description: Fresh and aromatic: bergamot, mandarin and pink peppercorn lead to lavender, iris and cardamom over fir balsam, tonka and white musks.

perfumes.name: Signorina
perfumes.description: Rose and pink pepper meet blackcurrant buds, then jasmine and peony melt into patchouli, musk and a creamy pannacotta accord.

perfumes.name: HUGO Man
perfumes.description: Lavender, apple, mint and grapefruit make a crisp, green opening. Geranium, jasmine and sage follow, with cedarwood, fir balsam and patchouli beneath.

perfumes.name: Red Aoud
perfumes.description: Citrus and lavender open onto rose, violet and patchouli. The base turns sweet and deep, with vanilla, toffee, tonka, oud, musk and amber, for a rich, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Riflesso
perfumes.description: Crisp green apple, pink grapefruit and bergamot lead to geranium, violet leaves and lavender, then tonka bean and vetiver join a note of Italian leather.

perfumes.name: Crystal Noir
perfumes.description: Mandarin, pink pepper and blackcurrant lead to tuberose, lily of the valley and caramel. Sandalwood, amber, vanilla and orchid keep it sweet and warm.

perfumes.name: Hypnotic Poison
perfumes.description: Bitter almond and sambac jasmine wrap around a creamy vanilla, producing a sweet, warm and slightly nutty bloom.

perfumes.name: Le Parfum
perfumes.description: Orange blossom opens bright over jasmine and patchouli. Cedarwood and honey give a sweet, earthy warmth.

perfumes.name: Paragon
perfumes.description: A smoky, aromatic woody scent: bergamot, white sage and lavender over palo santo, black pepper, sandalwood and agarwood.

perfumes.name: Weekend
perfumes.description: Mignonette, mandarin and sage open green, then hyacinth, iris, peach blossom and nectarine. Cedarwood, musk and sandalwood add a soft, powdery base.

perfumes.name: Moonlight in Heaven
perfumes.description: Grapefruit and mango give a fruity, sunlit start, supported by the roasted sweetness of tonka beans.

perfumes.name: Ô de Lancôme
perfumes.description: Lemon, mandarin and bergamot sparkle with honeysuckle, then basil, rosemary and jasmine. Oakmoss, sandalwood and vetiver close it fresh and herbal.

perfumes.name: Wūlóng Chá
perfumes.description: A tea-centred fresh scent. Bergamot, orange, litsea and mandarin open, oolong tea and nutmeg form the heart, and musk with fig finishes it softly.

perfumes.name: Honour Man
perfumes.description: A peppery, aromatic woody scent: two peppers and nutmeg give it bite, geranium and elemi add a green lift, and patchouli, vetiver, cedar and tonka settle it down.

perfumes.name: K by Dolce&Gabbana
perfumes.description: Juniper, cardamom and blood orange are crisp and bracing, with geranium, fig and sage following. Cedarwood, cypriol, vetiver and patchouli ground it.

perfumes.name: Habit Rouge
perfumes.description: Bitter orange brightens a spiced neroli heart. Beneath, leather, vanilla and amber build a warm, resinous base with a hint of oud.

perfumes.name: Angel Nova
perfumes.description: Raspberry and rose give a juicy floral sweetness, anchored by akigalawood. Fruity, rosy and gently woody.

perfumes.name: For Her
perfumes.description: Orange blossom, osmanthus and rose meet peach, with a warm bed of musk, amber, vanilla and vetiver beneath.

perfumes.name: Polo Red

perfumes.description: Blood orange and blackcurrant are juicy and tart, over pimento and rose. Sandalwood supports a fruity, spiced floral that feels playful.

perfumes.name: Tuberóza
perfumes.description: A tuberose-led white floral with ylang ylang, sweet orange and orange blossom on top, gardenia, jasmine and marigold in the heart, and amberwood, vetiver, sandalwood and musk below.

perfumes.name: Le Pavillon d'Or
perfumes.description: A woody aromatic scent: cool mint and thyme open it, fig leaf and heliotrope sit in the middle, and frankincense, oak and sandalwood give a resinous, dry base.

perfumes.name: Oligarch
perfumes.description: Bergamot, lavender, lime and thyme open sharp and aromatic, with orange blossom, jasmine, coconut and lily. Cut grass, galbanum, patchouli and cedarwood give a green, woody base.

perfumes.name: Guidance
perfumes.description: Pear, frankincense and hazelnut lead into saffron, rose and osmanthus. Labdanum, sandalwood, ambergris and vanilla make a warm, sweet and woody close.

perfumes.name: Idylle
perfumes.description: Lily, peony, freesia and white lilac open as a soft bouquet, around jasmine and Bulgarian rose, with patchouli and white musk below.

perfumes.name: Ocean Leather
perfumes.description: A salty, fresh leather: lemon, mandarin and pink pepper start it, clary sage and an aquatic accord run through the middle, and vetiver, marine leather and labdanum finish.

perfumes.name: Alien Man
perfumes.description: Lemon, mint and dill open a bright, herbal top over lavender, thyme and anise. Leather, osmanthus and geranium lead to a soft base of vanilla, amber and cashmeran.

perfumes.name: Narciso Rouge
perfumes.description: Bulgarian rose and red iris sit over a heart of musk. Tonka, vetiver and cedar wood give a powdery, sweet-woody finish.

perfumes.name: Hawas Ice
perfumes.description: Apple, lemon and bergamot with a thread of anise run into plum and orange blossom, settling on moss, amber, musk and driftwood.

perfumes.name: Evoke
perfumes.description: A classic floral-chypre feel: bergamot and pink pepper over rose, jasmine and iris, with oakmoss, patchouli and vanilla underneath.

perfumes.name: Synthetic Jungle
perfumes.description: Basil and lily of the valley bring a green, dewy freshness. Jasmine flows into patchouli, leaving an earthy, creamy trail.

perfumes.name: Quelques Fleurs L'Original
perfumes.description: A classic white-floral bouquet opens through green bergamot and herbs. Oakmoss, iris and musk end powdery.

perfumes.name: Ra'ed Silver
perfumes.description: Tangerine and spices open into cinnamon, clove and saffron. Amber, ambergris, leather and agar wood give a rich, resinous warmth.

perfumes.name: Divine Decadence
perfumes.description: Orange blossom, champagne and bergamot sparkle, then honeysuckle, gardenia and hydrangea bloom. Amber, saffron and vanilla keep it creamy and warm.

perfumes.name: Spicebomb Night Vision
perfumes.description: Green apple, grapefruit and cardamom sharpen the bergamot opening, with clary sage, geranium, rosemary and lavandin, and roasted almond, tonka and cedar below.

perfumes.name: Eternia
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, orange and pepper open brightly, then vetiver and frankincense bring a smoky resin. Saffron and sage close it, spiced and warm.

perfumes.name: 212 Heroes
perfumes.description: Mandarin and raspberry brighten a heart of jasmine and orange blossom. Sandalwood and cedarwood add a creamy, woody calm.

perfumes.name: Spice and Wood
perfumes.description: Bergamot, lemon and apple brighten a dry heart of clove, pimento, birch and patchouli. Iris, cedar, musk and oak moss anchor the base.

perfumes.name: Eau des Sens
perfumes.description: Orange blossom and bitter orange mingle with the green, gin-like note of juniper berries, then dry out to patchouli and angelica.

perfumes.name: Dangerous Complicity
perfumes.description: A tropical, sweet-spiced scent: rum, ginger and coconut open it, osmanthus, jasmine and ylang ylang follow, and patchouli, sandalwood and a woody-amber note close.

perfumes.name: Ambassador for Men
perfumes.description: Mandarin, apple and cardamom give a bright start, with lavender and pepper in the middle, then earthy vetiver, oakmoss and teak wood under a layer of vanilla.

perfumes.name: Amethyst
perfumes.description: Raspberry, blackberry and blackcurrant make a dark fruit opening, with ylang-ylang, peony and rose. Wood, musk and vanilla finish sweet.

perfumes.name: Layali
perfumes.description: A fruity floral with oud at its centre: dark plum, black currant and orange flower open, ylang ylang, rose and jasmine form the heart, and oud with amber closes it.

perfumes.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
perfumes.description: A resinous, leathery scent: bergamot, pepper, fir and laurel lead into rich flowers, then cade, resins, civet, leather, patchouli and vanilla form the base.

perfumes.name: Turathi Homme
perfumes.description: Coriander, violet leaf and bergamot open crisp, then rose and pepper. Vanilla, patchouli and amber add a warm, spiced softness.

perfumes.name: Madawi
perfumes.description: Pineapple brings a juicy brightness to a creamy orange blossom heart, which settles on earthy patchouli.

perfumes.name: Blue Talisman
perfumes.description: A fresh, airy musk with juicy pear, ginger and citrus on top, orange blossom in the heart, and a clean, woody-musky base.

perfumes.name: Oud & Bergamot
perfumes.description: Bergamot's bright peel gives way to cedarwood and a smooth, resinous oud, so a fresh start moves slowly into dark wood.

perfumes.name: Flower by Kenzo Poppy Bouquet
perfumes.description: Pear opens lightly, leading into rose and gardenia. A creamy, woody base lets the bouquet linger softly.

perfumes.name: Bergamask
perfumes.description: Bergamot and lemon sparkle, followed by lily of the valley, lavender and orange blossom. Cedarwood, musk and tonka bean keep it soft and fresh.

perfumes.name: L'Interdit Rouge
perfumes.description: Blood orange and ginger lift a creamy heart of orange blossom, jasmine and pimento, which settles on patchouli and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Gaultier Divine
perfumes.description: Pink berry and bergamot lift a heart of lily, jasmine and ylang ylang. Meringue, patchouli and musk make the base airy and sweet.

perfumes.name: Black
perfumes.description: Basil, mint and ginger open sharp and cool, then violet and cedarwood lead to a smoky base of frankincense, leather and musk.

perfumes.name: Rose Pompon
perfumes.description: A fruity rose: raspberry, blackcurrant and pink pepper open it, Bulgarian and Taif rose with violet make the heart, and patchouli with white musk carries the base.

perfumes.name: Chrome United
perfumes.description: Pepper, coriander and bergamot give a crisp, spiced start. Violet leaves and black tea add a cool green note before cedar and white musk.

perfumes.name: Flowerhead
perfumes.description: Bright and floral: angelica, lingonberry and lemon, then tuberose, rose and jasmine sambac over fresh amber and suede.

perfumes.name: Eden Sparkling Lychee 39
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant, lemon, lychee and apple sparkle over rose, lilac and jasmine sambac. Amber, cedarwood, musk and vanilla give a warm, soft base.

perfumes.name: Eau de Rochas
perfumes.description: A fresh, summery citrus chypre: bergamot, mandarin, lemon and verbena open onto a floral core of narcissus and jasmine plus lily of the valley, with oak moss, myrrh and patchouli beneath.

perfumes.name: This is Her!
perfumes.description: Jasmine glows against a sweet, nutty heart of chestnut and vanilla, drying to a smooth sandalwood base.

perfumes.name: Tardes
perfumes.description: Almond and geranium open sweet, with plum and cedarwood in the heart. Tonka bean and heliotrope give a soft, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Esprit du Tigre
perfumes.description: A sharp, minty-spiced scent: camphor and mints cool the opening, cardamom, clove and black pepper add heat, and vetiver and cinnamon close it.

perfumes.name: Replica Coffee Break
perfumes.description: A café-inspired scent: coffee, red apple and lemon, then lavender, spearmint and orange flower, finishing on milk mousse, sandalwood and cedarwood. Comforting, creamy and lightly herbal.

perfumes.name: Juniper Sling
perfumes.description: Juniper berries and orange meet cinnamon and cardamom, then leather, orris and pepper. Vetiver, cherry, brown sugar and ambrox sweeten the ending.

perfumes.name: Infusion de Fleur d'Oranger
perfumes.description: Neroli and orange blossom feel bright and creamy, deepening with jasmine and sandalwood. A smooth, woody floral that stays serene.

perfumes.name: Signorina Libera
perfumes.description: Pear, bergamot and elemi are bright, with iris, rose and plum in the heart. Sugar, cashmere wood and ambroxan make a powdery, soft base.

perfumes.name: Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria
perfumes.description: Calabrian bergamot and citron shine over cedarwood and red ginger, then ease into a quiet finish of vetiver, benzoin and musk.

perfumes.name: Cloud
perfumes.description: A soft gourmand: lavender, pear and bergamot open lightly, coconut, praline and vanilla orchid make a creamy heart, and a cashmere base keeps it plush.

perfumes.name: Eau Parfumée au Thé Vert
perfumes.description: Bergamot, shiso and neroli feel green and light, with tea and violet at the heart. Iris and musk lend a powdery, quiet finish.

perfumes.name: Noa
perfumes.description: Peach and freesia over fresh green leaves lead into soft lily and jasmine, then a warm, creamy base of vanilla, sandalwood and tonka bean with a trace of coffee.

perfumes.name: Boss Bottled Night
perfumes.description: Birch and lavender are dry and smoky, with a violet heart. Woody notes and musk keep it powdery and calm.

perfumes.name: Chocolate Greedy
perfumes.description: A dessert-like blend where bitter orange gives way to cacao and vanilla, finishing on coffee bean and tonka. Sweet, roasted and rich, with a gourmand warmth throughout.

perfumes.name: Osmanthus
perfumes.description: A fruity-floral scent: pomelo, davana and pimento open onto osmanthus, water lily and jasmine over cedarwood, labdanum, musk and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Versense
perfumes.description: Bergamot, fig, mandarin and pear make a juicy citrus opening. Lily, jasmine and cardamom flow into sandalwood, cedarwood and musk.

perfumes.name: Eilish
perfumes.description: Sugared red berries and mandarin lead to rose, chocolate and a touch of spice, melting into amber, tonka bean and soft musk.

perfumes.name: Escentric 03
perfumes.description: Ginger, lime and pepper are bright and spiced, with iris, jasmine and tea. Vetiver, musk, sandalwood and cedarwood add a woody, clean base.

perfumes.name: Moscow Mule
perfumes.description: A sparkling citrus-and-ginger scent: bergamot, lime and ginger over jasmine and apple, with a clean musky-amber finish.

perfumes.name: Legend Night
perfumes.description: A dark, sweet-aromatic fragrance with cardamom, mint and clary sage on top, apple, lavender and violet in the heart, and a vanilla, musk, patchouli and vetiver base.

perfumes.name: Eau de Campagne
perfumes.description: A garden after rain: bergamot, basil and cut grass sharpen a green heart of tomato leaf and jasmine, grounded by oakmoss, vetiver and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Rolling in Love
perfumes.description: A soft, powdery floral-musk: almond milk and ambrette open it, iris and freesia sit in the heart, and musk, tonka bean and tuberose make a creamy base.

perfumes.name: Voyage
perfumes.description: Crisp apple and green leaves meet water lily and mimosa, then dry down through cedarwood, oakmoss and amber with a clean musk.

perfumes.name: Zenne
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, blackcurrant and rhubarb give a tart, juicy start. Turkish rose, gardenia and sandalwood follow, ending on vanilla, ambergris and musk for a creamy, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Oceania
perfumes.description: A fresh, herbal, mossy scent: many citrus and herb notes open it, geranium and jasmine make the heart, and galbanum, vetiver, cedar, vanilla and musk finish.

perfumes.name: Journey Man
perfumes.description: A bright citrus-and-spice opening of Sichuan pepper, bergamot and cardamom leads to juniper, frankincense and tobacco, ending in a leathery, sweet-woody base with tonka and cypriol.

perfumes.name: Velvet Tender Oud
perfumes.description: Leather opens against a rose heart, with oud beneath. Floral, smoky and resinous.

perfumes.name: Lalibela
perfumes.description: Rose, patchouli oil and incense: a dark, earthy floral that smolders softly, with a smoky, resinous undertone.

perfumes.name: Alien Hypersense
perfumes.description: Green mandarin and a pear accord brighten jasmine sambac, which sits above a woody, warm cashmeran base.

perfumes.name: For Her Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Peach and rose are soft and fruity, set over a heart of musk. Patchouli and amber add an earthy warmth.

perfumes.name: Polo Double Black
perfumes.description: Pepper and mango open spicy and juicy, with nutmeg and coffee at the heart. Juniper, wood and cardamom give a dark, warm base.

perfumes.name: La Yuqawam
perfumes.description: Thyme and saffron meet a bright raspberry edge, then smoke through frankincense into a dry base of leather, suede and amber.

perfumes.name: Cheirosa 62
perfumes.description: Pistachio and almond lead into a soft heliotrope and jasmine heart, then pool into vanilla, caramel and creamy sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Ursa
perfumes.description: Nutmeg, elemi, dried fruits and rum open rich and boozy. Frankincense, tobacco and vetiver deepen into vanilla, leather and oud.

perfumes.name: Amber Wood
perfumes.description: Lavender, cardamom and a crisp apple lead to cedarwood and powdery iris, drying down into warm amber and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Pacific Lime
perfumes.description: Lime, mint and lemon are cool and zesty, softened by coconut. Musk makes a clean, sweet finish.

perfumes.name: Mayar
perfumes.description: A sweet fruity floral opening with raspberry, litchi and black currant, a rose and magnolia heart, and a soft amber and patchouli base.

perfumes.name: Spicebomb Dark Leather
perfumes.description: Pepper and nutmeg give way to incense and cinnamon, then leather and tobacco. A dark, smoky spice with a resinous warmth that lingers.

perfumes.name: Island Bliss
perfumes.description: Tropical and creamy: wild berries and green notes open, coconut, orange blossom, lactones and water lily follow, finishing on vanilla, tonka and musk.

perfumes.name: 212 VIP Black
perfumes.description: Absinthe and lavender feel cool and herbal, with leather adding a smoky edge before a sweet, soft base of vanilla and musk.

perfumes.name: Bois du Portugal
perfumes.description: Bergamot and lavender lead into cedarwood, then sandalwood, vetiver and ambergris. A fresh, herbal woodiness that stays composed and dry.

perfumes.name: Like This
perfumes.description: A spiced, golden scent: mandarin, ginger and a pumpkin accord open it, immortelle, neroli and rose form the heart, and vetiver, heliotrope and musk soften it.

perfumes.name: Ambassador Intense
perfumes.description: Cardamom, nutmeg and pink pepper spice a heart of raspberry, caramel and jasmine, deepening into tonka bean, vanilla, leather and labdanum.

perfumes.name: Glow
perfumes.description: Orange blossom and neroli float over a creamy heart of jasmine, rose and tuberose, resting on sandalwood, amber, vanilla and a powdery iris trace.

perfumes.name: Perles de Lalique
perfumes.description: Rose and iris open soft, with pepper and patchouli in the heart. Cashmere wood leaves a powdery, earthy finish.

perfumes.name: Kashkha
perfumes.description: A fruity, spicy oud: bergamot, apple and cinnamon open it sharply, saffron, cardamom and oud follow, and cedarwood, amber and musk give a smooth, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Camel
perfumes.description: A desert-inspired scent: dried fruit, date and frankincense open it, then amber, cinnamon, incense and floral notes, ending on oud, sandalwood and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Amber Sky
perfumes.description: A sweet, woody amber: coriander seed and bergamot open it, geranium and nutmeg add warmth, and cedar, sandalwood, vanilla and tonka bean fill the base.

perfumes.name: Oud Silk Mood
perfumes.description: Rose and oud meet at the start, resinous and floral together. Chamomile softens the heart and papyrus adds a dry, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Bergamote
perfumes.description: A sparkling citrus: bergamot and ginger up front, orange blossom and green leaves in the middle, and a clean base of rhubarb wood and white musk.

perfumes.name: Moonlight Patchouli
perfumes.description: Patchouli, chocolate and wood open dark and sweet, with rose and iris in the heart. Suede and leather add a smoky, powdery softness.

perfumes.name: Detour Noir
perfumes.description: Sparkling bergamot, mandarin and pepper give way to violet and jasmine, then a creamy, woody base of sandalwood, patchouli and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Narcisse Noir
perfumes.description: A heady floral led by jonquil and orange blossom, with orange and jasmine at its core, drying down to vetiver and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: J'Ose
perfumes.description: Mint, lemon and bergamot open crisp, then coffee and lavender add a dark herbal turn before a sweet, woody base of tonka bean, vanilla and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Reaction
perfumes.description: Lime, melon and apple stay light and juicy, with lily of the valley at the centre and a soft musk and sandalwood finish.

perfumes.name: Duro
perfumes.description: Leather opens dry and dark, with smoke in the heart. Spice and wood keep it smoky and leathery.

perfumes.name: Sì Passione
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant and bergamot sparkle over rose and jasmine. Cedarwood and patchouli ground this fruity floral in a woody base.

perfumes.name: La Tulipe
perfumes.description: A green, airy floral: cyclamen, freesia and rhubarb around a tulip heart, with blonde woods and vetiver below.

perfumes.name: Habanita
perfumes.description: Raspberry, peach and orange blossom brighten a powdery heart of iris, lilac and heliotrope, closing in leather, benzoin and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Replica On a Date
perfumes.description: A warm, fruity evening scent with a blackcurrant liquor accord, bergamot and pink pepper, a heart of rose, geranium and davana, and patchouli, vetiver, moss and musks below.

perfumes.name: Oajan
perfumes.description: Honey, cinnamon and osmanthus open sweet and spiced. Amber, labdanum and benzoin deepen it, with vanilla, tonka bean and patchouli in a resinous base.

perfumes.name: Sweet Like Candy
perfumes.description: A fruity-floral sweet scent: blackberry, bergamot and pear at the top, white flowers in the heart, then cassis, marshmallow, soft woods and vanilla below.

perfumes.name: Man Extreme
perfumes.description: Bergamot and cactus open fresh, followed by freesia, cardamom and amber. Benzoin, vetiver and wood make a warm, spiced base.

perfumes.name: Dark Purple
perfumes.description: Plum and orange open a fruity rose heart that adds geranium, patchouli and red berries. Grey amber, teakwood and musk close it with a dusky, sweet and woody finish.

perfumes.name: Royal Amber
perfumes.description: Bergamot and green leaves brighten a sweet melon and pineapple heart, which melts into amber, vanilla and gentle musk.

perfumes.name: Blue Jeans
perfumes.description: Galbanum, juniper and citrus make a green, fresh start, with violet, lavender and jasmine behind them. Iris, musk and soft woods leave a powdery finish.

perfumes.name: Eilish No. 2
perfumes.description: Apple blossom and bergamot brighten a dry heart of papyrus, poppy and pepper, which settles into ebony wood, palo santo and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Dior Homme Intense
perfumes.description: Powdery iris gives way to ambrette's soft, skin-like musk, then settles on smooth cedarwood. Clean, quiet and gently woody.

perfumes.name: Pear Inc.
perfumes.description: A juicy pear accord over a soft cetalox heart and musks, giving a clean, fruity skin scent.

perfumes.name: Roses Greedy
perfumes.description: A fruity, gourmand rose. Mandarin, peach, coconut and blackcurrant meet French rose, jasmine and aquatic flowers, then amber, vanilla, white musk and benzoin sweeten the base.

perfumes.name: Emblem
perfumes.description: Cardamom, clary sage and grapefruit open fresh and green, with cinnamon and violet leaf at the heart. Tonka bean and woody notes warm the end.

perfumes.name: Flower of Immortality
perfumes.description: White peach, silky iris butter and tonka bean make a powdery, fruit-soft scent that dries down to a gentle sweetness.

perfumes.name: La Vie est Belle Intensément
perfumes.description: Bergamot, pink pepper and raspberry brighten a creamy heart of jasmine sambac and orange blossom. Patchouli, iris, benzoin and vanilla make a warm, soft base.

perfumes.name: Karagoz
perfumes.description: Black grape and pineapple come with a bundle of herbs at the top, neroli and jasmine in the middle, then agarwood, vetiver and amber, leaving a dry, woody trail.

perfumes.name: Mélodie de l'Amour
perfumes.description: A white floral built on gardenia, tuberose and jasmine, lifted at the start by peach and broom, and warmed underneath with honey, cedarwood and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Reckless Pour Femme
perfumes.description: A warm, floral-spiced scent: bergamot and mandarin open it, geranium, rose and neroli follow, and coriander, cinnamon, sandalwood, vanilla and musk close it.

perfumes.name: Opus I
perfumes.description: Cardamom, bitter orange and plum precede a lush bouquet of jasmine, tuberose and rose. Vetiver, sandalwood and frankincense give a deep, creamy woodiness.

perfumes.name: The Only One
perfumes.description: Bergamot and violet brighten a powdery heart of coffee and iris, over a sweet, warm base of patchouli and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Terracotta
perfumes.description: Bergamot and coconut milk open into ylang ylang, jasmine and orange blossom with a tiare accord. Vanilla, benzoin and white musk make it creamy.

perfumes.name: Shuhrah
perfumes.description: Rose and tomato leaf open crisp and green, turning to jasmine and sandalwood before a dark, earthy finish of oud, oakmoss and leather.

perfumes.name: Wisal Dhahab
perfumes.description: A fruity floral: mandarin, apple and pear open brightly, orchid, jasmine and rose fill the middle, and musk, sandalwood and patchouli leave a soft woody base.

perfumes.name: Haya
perfumes.description: A bright fruity floral for women: champagne, strawberry and citrus open, gardenia and jasmine bloom in the heart, and amber, sandalwood and chestnut warm the base.

perfumes.name: Cologne du Maghreb
perfumes.description: A herbal, dry citrus cologne with many top notes, from mandarin and rosemary to lavender, followed by neroli and rose, and finished on cedar, vetiver and labdanum.

perfumes.name: Hunter Intense
perfumes.description: A citrus-and-floral scent: bergamot, pomelo, mandarin and lemon on top, lavender, geranium, ylang ylang and tuberose in the heart, with black pepper and cardamom at the base.

perfumes.name: 212 Sexy
perfumes.description: Mandarin and bergamot open fresh, cardamom and pepper add spice, and sandalwood with vanilla keeps the finish warm and soft.

perfumes.name: Heliotrope
perfumes.description: A sweet, powdery floral with an almond-and-vanilla gourmand side: hawthorn, orange blossom and heliotrope lead into tonka bean, musk and balsam of Peru.

perfumes.name: Earl Grey & Cucumber
perfumes.description: Bergamot gives the Earl Grey its citrus lift, cool cucumber adds a watery green, and beeswax leaves a faint honeyed softness.

perfumes.name: Boccanera
perfumes.description: Pepper, ginger and coconut open spiced and sweet, with jasmine in the heart. Leather, vanilla, chocolate, patchouli and musk make a dark, warm base.

perfumes.name: Oriental Lounge
perfumes.description: An oriental spicy scent: sweet pepper and bergamot start it, red rose and satinwood form the heart, and amber, tonka bean and labdanum make a rich resinous base.

perfumes.name: Play
perfumes.description: Bitter orange and grapefruit are sharp and bright, over amyris and vetiver. Citrus, woody and a little earthy.

perfumes.name: Le Beau Le Parfum
perfumes.description: Bergamot lights the opening before creamy coconut and tonka beans take over, giving a sunny, sweet and relaxed trail.

perfumes.name: Nuit Étoilée
perfumes.description: Lemon, mint and orange are cool and sparkling, with pine and fir balsam at the heart. Tonka bean and immortelle leave a gently sweet trail.

perfumes.name: Eyes Closed
perfumes.description: Spicy and earthy: cardamom and cinnamon, then carrot, ginger and orris butter, over papyrus and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Olibanum
perfumes.description: An incense-led scent: orange blossom at the top, frankincense and myrrh at the core, on a base of sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Valaya
perfumes.description: A luminous white-floral musk: bergamot, mandarin and white peach, then orange blossom, finishing on musks, vanilla and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Colony
perfumes.description: Bergamot, pineapple and orange open bright, with jasmine, rose, nutmeg and clove. Leather, patchouli, vetiver and amber give a spiced, warm base.

perfumes.name: R.E.M.
perfumes.description: A dreamy gourmand: quince, fig, salted caramel and marshmallow lead, pear and lavender blossom add a soft floral centre, and tonka, white musk and sandalwood close it.

perfumes.name: Omnia Coral
perfumes.description: Goji berry and bergamot brighten hibiscus and water lily. Pomegranate and cedarwood add a light fruitiness and a clean, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Incident Diplomatique
perfumes.description: A woody, dry scent: mandarin opens it, vetiver and nutmeg make the middle, and patchouli with sandalwood form the base.

perfumes.name: Starry Nights
perfumes.description: Bergamot and lemon brighten a heart of rose, jasmine and patchouli leaves. Amber, vanilla and white musk give a smooth, sweet and softly floral dry-down.

perfumes.name: Sauvage Elixir
perfumes.description: A dense blend of spice and lavender resting on woody depth. Herbal, warm and concentrated, with a fresh edge that lingers around the spice.

perfumes.name: Vert Fougère
perfumes.description: Grapefruit and lavender are crisp and herbal, over a soft amber base. A clean, green fougère feel.

perfumes.name: Psychedelic Love
perfumes.description: A resinous, sweet rose: bergamot and rose with myrrh, vanilla, patchouli and heliotropin, lightened with hedione.

perfumes.name: Midnight Oud
perfumes.description: A smoky, woody scent: birch and rose open, cedar, oud and patchouli form the core, and guaiac wood with cetalox closes it.

perfumes.name: Explorer Extreme
perfumes.description: Bergamot's brightness meets earthy patchouli, and a warm amber accord rounds it out.

perfumes.name: Trésor Midnight Rose
perfumes.description: Raspberry and blackcurrant brighten a rose and jasmine heart, which settles into soft vanilla and musk. Fruity, floral and sweet.

perfumes.name: Sultan Vetiver
perfumes.description: A vetiver study from several origins: Javanese, Bourbon, Haitian and Brazilian. Absinthe, schinus molle, bergamot, neroli, tonka, amberwood and leather support it. Green, earthy and smooth.

perfumes.name: Futur
perfumes.description: A floral-woody extrait: neroli and bergamot open it, jasmine, ylang ylang and violet form the heart, and vetiver, cedar and patchouli close it.

perfumes.name: Apex Pour Homme
perfumes.description: A huge, layered composition: bright citrus and jasmine open it, then a very long base mixes galbanum, oakmoss, tobacco, rum, sandalwood, resins, leather and musk.

perfumes.name: Cinéma
perfumes.description: Cyclamen, mandarin and almond open sweetly, leading into amaryllis, jasmine and peony. Amber, musk and vanilla close it in a warm, creamy glow.

perfumes.name: Cap Camarat
perfumes.description: A sunny, creamy coastal scent: pink pepper and a crisp apple note, ylang ylang and jasmine in the middle, then a resinous base of sandalwood, benzoin, patchouli and labdanum.

perfumes.name: Cristal
perfumes.description: Bergamot, freesia and orange blossom lead to rose, jasmine and musk. Cedarwood, cashmere wood and benzoin make a creamy, woody base.

perfumes.name: Dahn Al Oudh Moattaq
perfumes.description: Turkish rose and oud sit side by side, resinous and warm, with amber and a soft powdery musk drawing the edges together.

perfumes.name: Eclaire
perfumes.description: A confectionery gourmand built on caramel, milk and sugar, with honey and white flowers in the heart and a creamy vanilla, praline and musk base.

perfumes.name: Daisy Ever So Fresh
perfumes.description: Mandarin, mango and pineapple make a bright, juicy opening, softening to rose and orange blossom. Cashmere wood leaves a smooth finish.

perfumes.name: Orange Star
perfumes.description: A juicy, clean citrus-floral: mandarin and clementine sparkle over lemongrass and orange flower, then drift into a soft base of ambergris, tonka bean and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Rose Prick
perfumes.description: A spiced rose: Bulgarian rose and turmeric with patchouli and Sichuan pepper, finished by roasted tonka and balsam.

perfumes.name: Eau de Toilette Spicebomb Fresh
perfumes.description: Pink pepper and pepper spark over lavender, elemi and a touch of salt, drying down to tobacco, moss and amber. Crisp, spicy and herbal.

perfumes.name: Volutes
perfumes.description: Tobacco, honey and dried fruits glow beside iris, with saffron, hay and pepper in the heart. Myrrh, benzoin and styrax add a spiced resinous warmth.

perfumes.name: L'Eau d'Issey Pure
perfumes.description: Sea notes are clean and airy, opening onto jasmine, lily, rose and orange blossom. Ambergris and cashmere wood add a creamy, soft glow.

perfumes.name: Rare Carbon
perfumes.description: A spicy, leathery woody scent for men, with cinnamon and nutmeg over rose, violet and cedar, drying down to vetiver, sandalwood and amber.

perfumes.name: Vicolo Fiori
perfumes.description: A soft, juicy floral: mandarin and campanula over water lily, lotus, cyclamen and white peach, with a powdery base of iris, sandalwood and musk.

perfumes.name: Basil & Neroli
perfumes.description: Basil and neroli pair green herbal freshness with a soft floral heart. Musk lends a smooth, creamy finish.

perfumes.name: Seminalis
perfumes.description: Carnation opens spicy-sweet, with lily of the valley and raspberry. Cedarwood, leather, sandalwood and vanilla give a sugared, woody base.

perfumes.name: Million Gold For Her
perfumes.description: Rose and a white-flower bouquet meet a clean, mineral musk. Soft, bright and quietly creamy.

perfumes.name: Sel de Vétiver
perfumes.description: A woody aromatic with a salty edge: cardamom and grapefruit open, Haitian vetiver, patchouli and geranium lead the heart, and sea salt, iris and ylang-ylang sit underneath.

perfumes.name: Collection Extraordinaire Santal Blanc
perfumes.description: Mandarin and fig open onto powdery violet and sandalwood, ending in a soft, sweet drydown of musk and tonka bean.

perfumes.name: Oudh 36
perfumes.description: Ylang-ylang and rose lie over a dense, resinous base of labdanum, amber and benzoin, with patchouli and cedarwood adding depth.

perfumes.name: Fleur de Rocaille
perfumes.description: A powdery white-floral where gardenia and orange blossom open onto rose and lily of the valley, resting on cedar and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: La Belle Le Parfum
perfumes.description: Pear's soft juiciness meets a smooth vanilla and tonka bean for a sweet, warm and simple trio.
Peppery juniper opens to leather, orris and violet, resting on black amber, patchouli and vanilla for a smooth, slightly dark finish.

perfumes.name: Confetto
perfumes.description: Anise and almond start sweet and sugared, over an amber heart. Vanilla and musk make a warm, soft finish.

perfumes.name: Fierce Cologne
perfumes.description: Lemon, orange and fir balsam feel crisp and resinous. Jasmine, rosemary and lily of the valley follow, settling into oakmoss, musk and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Arancia di Capri
perfumes.description: Mandarin, orange and lemon open juicy and bright, with petitgrain and cardamom adding a green, spicy lift. Musk and caramel give the base a soft, faintly sweet finish.

perfumes.name: Arancia Di Capri La Riserva
perfumes.description: A bright Mediterranean citrus: blood orange and mandarin open over rosemary, basil and a salty mineral touch, then dry down to cedar and soft suede.

perfumes.name: Blu Mediterraneo Arancia di Capri
perfumes.description: Orange, mandarin and lemon give a sunny, sparkling opening, with petitgrain and cardamom adding a touch of green spice. Caramel and musk close it soft, sweet and clean.

perfumes.name: Buongiorno
perfumes.description: A bright herbal wake-up: lemon, spearmint and rosemary give way to lavandin and petitgrain before a clean base of cedar, amber and musk.

perfumes.name: Buongiorno Al Bacio
perfumes.description: Light and kind to the skin: bergamot and rosemary lead into orange blossom and neroli, resting on musk and pale woods.

perfumes.name: Buongiorno Amore Mio
perfumes.description: A soft, laundered cloud: sparkling bergamot and aldehydes over cotton, iris and a hedione glow, closing on musks and an ambroxan trail.

perfumes.name: Buongiorno Buonanotte
perfumes.description: A calm, powdery evening wood: bergamot and pink pepper melt into iris and guaiac, then settle on cedar, musk and cashmere wood.

perfumes.name: Buongiorno Dolce Far Niente
perfumes.description: Lemony and unhurried: citrus peels brighten a heart of lemon and fig wood, ending on cedar, musk and sticky labdanum.

perfumes.name: Buongiorno Gioco Del Destino
perfumes.description: Golden and playful: mandarins and orange open onto wheat, ginger and benzoin, ending in a smooth base of musk, sandalwood and balsam.

perfumes.name: Colonia
perfumes.description: The classic cologne shape: lemon, orange and bergamot over lavender, rosemary and verbena, with a little rose. Vetiver, sandalwood and patchouli add a dry, earthy base that keeps it crisp.

perfumes.name: Colonia Il Profumo
perfumes.description: The classic cologne gently deepened: bergamot, grapefruit and blood orange over rosemary and ylang-ylang, anchored by vetiver and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Colonia Pura
perfumes.description: Bergamot, orange and petitgrain feel clean and sunny, with coriander and jasmine sambac in the middle and cedarwood and musk below.

perfumes.name: Crystal Incense
perfumes.description: Spicy and shimmering: grapefruit, black pepper and ginger lift cardamom, settling on patchouli, benzoin and musk.

perfumes.name: Fico di Amalfi
perfumes.description: Lemon, bergamot and grapefruit sit over green fig, pink pepper and jasmine, drying into fig wood, cedarwood and benzoin.

perfumes.name: Gelsomino A Freddo
perfumes.description: Jasmine served cold: lemon, pink pepper and artemisia frame jasmine, tea and iris, with guaiac, patchouli and cypriol underneath.

perfumes.name: Gelsomino A Freddo Ambrosia
perfumes.description: A richer take on chilled jasmine: cardamom, lemon and frankincense over jasmine, tea, iris and myrrh, finishing on sandalwood, vetiver and cedar.

perfumes.name: Mandarino Di Sicilia
perfumes.description: Sweet-sharp citrus grove: mandarin, bergamot, lemon and blood orange over petitgrain and spearmint, finishing soft on patchouli, cedar and musk.

perfumes.name: Mandorlo di Sicilia
perfumes.description: Almond sits at the centre, soft and slightly sweet, with ylang-ylang adding a floral glow. Bergamot, anise and orange lift the start, while vanilla, balsam and musk make the base creamy.

perfumes.name: Mirto Di Panarea La Riserva
perfumes.description: A Mediterranean herb garden: cedrat, sage and juniper lead to myrtle, lavender and myrrh, finishing on patchouli, labdanum and mastic.

perfumes.name: Note Di Colonia I
perfumes.description: An airy cologne with a floral turn: bergamot and neroli meet lavender, rose and a violet accord over patchouli and cedar.

perfumes.name: Note Di Colonia Ii
perfumes.description: Citrus-forward and cleanly woody: bergamot, orange and grapefruit with cardamom and basil, then sandalwood, guaiac, musk and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Note Di Colonia Iii
perfumes.description: A warmer cologne: mandarin and ginger open onto vetiver, frankincense and jasmine, finishing with tonka bean, myrrh and cistus.

perfumes.name: Note Di Colonia Iv
perfumes.description: Citrus and rose with a resinous glow: bergamot and green mandarin, Turkish rose and orange flower, then opoponax, labdanum and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Note Di Colonia V
perfumes.description: Crisp and dry: Calabrian lemon, bergamot and pink pepper warmed by ginger and juniper, over sandalwood and cedar.

perfumes.name: Quercia
perfumes.description: A citrus-to-forest walk: lemon, bergamot and petitgrain, then cardamom, geranium and cedar, ending on tonka bean, patchouli and oakmoss.

perfumes.name: Sandalo
perfumes.description: Fresh citrus meets creamy wood: bergamot, lemon and orange with lavender and cardamom, resting on sandalwood, amber and tonka bean.

perfumes.name: Yuzu
perfumes.description: Sparkling yuzu with a light floral heart of lotus, mimosa and jasmine, finishing on soft musk, liquorice and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Zafferano
perfumes.description: Sunny spice and flowers: mandarin, bergamot and coriander over jasmine sambac, saffron and rose, finishing on vanilla, tonka bean and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Zafferano Ambrosia
perfumes.description: Saffron-led and golden: mandarin, bergamot and ginger over saffron, orange flower and jasmine, then vanilla, patchouli and an amber accord.

perfumes.name: 9 AM
perfumes.description: Mandarin, cardamom and pink pepper open bright and spiced, lavender, orange blossom, rose and apple bloom in the heart, and cedarwood, oakmoss, patchouli and musk settle in.

perfumes.name: 9 AM Dive
perfumes.description: Lemon, pink pepper, mint and blackcurrant open cool and juicy, apple, incense and cedarwood take the heart, and patchouli, jasmine, ginger and sandalwood close woody and warm.

perfumes.name: 9 PM
perfumes.description: A bright, spiced opening of apple, cinnamon, lavender and bergamot gives way to orange blossom and lily of the valley, before tonka bean, vanilla, amber and patchouli close sweet and warm.

perfumes.name: 9 PM Rebel
perfumes.description: Sweet and woody, with mandarin and apple on top, cedarwood and vanilla in the middle, and a warm caramel and musk base.

perfumes.name: Adwaa Al Sharq
perfumes.description: Saffron, jasmine and caramel begin warm and sweet, amberwood, ambergris and musk give the heart a clean glow, and fir balsam, cedarwood and musk close soft and resinous.

perfumes.name: Delicious Bouquet
perfumes.description: Lemon, vanilla and bergamot begin sweet and bright, orange blossom, honey, rum and sugar make a rich heart, and tonka bean, musk, caramel and vanilla close warm.

perfumes.name: Ebdaa Concentrated Perfume Oil
perfumes.description: Mandarin and bergamot sparkle, blackcurrant, raspberry and amber make a fruity heart, and cedarwood, vanilla and powdery notes leave a soft base.

perfumes.name: Edict Amberythme
perfumes.description: Cinnamon and tonka bean warm amber from the top, saffron, jasmine and vanilla fill the heart, and sandalwood, cedarwood and ambergris leave a sweet, woody base.

perfumes.name: Edict Musctique
perfumes.description: Cardamom and musk open with soft, spiced warmth; a heart of vanilla with lily of the valley follows, and oud, mint and musk close with a cool, resinous edge.

perfumes.name: Historic Olmeda
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, juniper, cardamom and pink pepper open sharp and bright, jasmine, nutmeg, cedarwood and bergamot form the heart, and musk, ambergris, apple and patchouli close warm.

perfumes.name: Historic Sahara
perfumes.description: Bergamot, cinnamon and cardamom open warm and bright, elemi, vanilla and sugar sweeten the heart, and musk, almond, tonka bean, praline and ambroxan leave a creamy base.

perfumes.name: Inara White
perfumes.description: Fruit and jasmine start sweet, cedarwood and vanilla warm the heart, and woody notes with amber close dry and soft.

perfumes.name: Kiaana Crush
perfumes.description: Saffron opens the way for passion fruit, patchouli and oud, then incense, cedarwood, musk, ambroxan and vanilla leave a resinous, warm base.

perfumes.name: La Fleur Bouquet
perfumes.description: Orange blossom, jasmine and peony open soft, lychee, peach and bergamot sweeten the heart, and musk, oakmoss and Petalia close creamy and light.

perfumes.name: Lynked Forever
perfumes.description: Mandarin and wild berries start juicy, gardenia, tuberose and ylang-ylang bloom in the heart, and coconut, sandalwood, musk and wood close creamy.

perfumes.name: Malak
perfumes.description: Marshmallow, lemon and apple sweeten the opening, musk, coconut and orange blossom make a soft heart, and amber, vanilla and sugar close warm.

perfumes.name: Mirsaal of Trust
perfumes.description: Vetiver and Ambrofix open with an earthy lift, saffron and raspberry bring a fruity spice, and amber, carnation and cashmere wood close warm.

perfumes.name: Modest Deux
perfumes.description: Raspberry and blackcurrant meet rose, then peony and jasmine add a gentle spice before cedarwood, patchouli and musk settle underneath.

perfumes.name: Modest Une
perfumes.description: Bergamot, pepper and lavender open crisp, pink pepper, geranium and elemi warm the heart, and ambroxan, vetiver and patchouli leave an earthy base.

perfumes.name: Mystique Bouquet
perfumes.description: Lychee, bergamot, mandarin and peach open bright, peony, mahonia, vetiver and orange blossom bloom in the heart, and oakmoss, vanilla, musk and ambroxan close soft.

perfumes.name: Ornament pour Femme
perfumes.description: Passion fruit, coconut, peach and bergamot open tropical, orange blossom and vetiver anchor the heart, and amber, vanilla and musk finish sweet and warm.

perfumes.name: Ornament pour Homme
perfumes.description: Apple, lavandin and geranium start green and bright, sandalwood, patchouli and amber warm the heart, and cedarwood, musk and oakmoss finish earthy.

perfumes.name: Ornament Purple
perfumes.description: Mandarin, raspberry and grapefruit open juicy, toffee, white flowers, anise and cardamom give a sweet, spiced heart, and musk, vanilla and patchouli close soft.

perfumes.name: Oud Rising
perfumes.description: Oud, cypress and orange blossom open dark and green, rosewood, cardamom and amber build a spiced heart, and vetiver, musk and tonka bean leave a warm base.

perfumes.name: Paris Oud
perfumes.description: Orange, lemon and blackcurrant start bright, wood, ylang-ylang and amber warm the heart, and powdery notes, musk and tonka bean leave a soft base.

perfumes.name: Patchouli on Fire
perfumes.description: Spicy, aromatic and woody notes open, patchouli, lavender and citrus fill the heart, and patchouli with spicy notes closes earthy and dry.

perfumes.name: Portrait Abstract
perfumes.description: Vetiver, rhubarb and incense open dry and tart, rose and tonka bean soften the heart, and sandalwood, leather, cedarwood and amber leave a warm, woody base.

perfumes.name: Portrait Revival
perfumes.description: Cinnamon, honey, saffron and incense open warm and sweet, tonka bean, oakwood and praline deepen the heart, and dates, sandalwood, caramel and chocolate make a rich base.

perfumes.name: Rare Passion
perfumes.description: Orange, musk and rose open soft, amber, wood and vanilla warm the heart, and rose, musk and orange blossom close floral and clean.

perfumes.name: Rare Reef
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant, grapefruit and mint sparkle over apricot, basil and rose. Fig and dates add a soft, fruity depth at the base. Fresh, herbal and bright.

perfumes.name: Souvenir Blooming Bliss
perfumes.description: Vanilla opens sweet, coconut, palo santo and caramel make a creamy heart, and musk and sandalwood close soft and warm.

perfumes.name: Souvenir Desert Rose
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant, raspberry and peach open fruity, musk with heliotrope and lily of the valley makes a powdery heart, and amber, citrus and sandalwood close soft.

perfumes.name: Souvenir Floral Bouquet
perfumes.description: Lychee, rhubarb and bergamot open fresh and fruity, rose, lily of the valley, peony and vanilla form a floral heart, and musk, cashmere wood and amber close soft.

perfumes.name: Supremacy Collectors Edition
perfumes.description: Pineapple, bergamot and apple open fruity, orange blossom, birch and amber warm the heart, and oakmoss, musk and ambergris leave an earthy base.

perfumes.name: Supremacy Collector's Edition
perfumes.description: Pineapple, apple and bergamot lead fruity, orange blossom and birch sit with amber in the heart, and oakmoss, musk and ambergris close warm and earthy.

perfumes.name: Supremacy Gala
perfumes.description: Mandarin, red berries and pear blossom open soft and sweet, honeysuckle, frangipani and gardenia form a creamy heart, and patchouli, praline, caramel, brown sugar and vanilla close rich.

perfumes.name: Supremacy Gold
perfumes.description: Ylang-ylang and neroli open creamy, vetiver, musk and vanilla soften the heart, and jasmine, musk and sandalwood close warm.

perfumes.name: Supremacy in Heaven
perfumes.description: Bergamot and mandarin brighten the start, tea and blackcurrant form a fresh heart, and musk, sandalwood and wood leave a soft finish.

perfumes.name: Supremacy Pink
perfumes.description: Pink pepper and violet open with a gentle spice, rose, peony and lily of the valley form a powdery floral heart, and musk and amber close warm.

perfumes.name: Supremacy Purple
perfumes.description: Orange, bergamot and peach open fruity and bright, amber and musk warm the heart, and pear, musk and vanilla close soft.

perfumes.description: Bergamot, pimento and nutmeg open spiced and bright, cashmere wood and amber warm the heart, and vetiver, incense and musk leave a dry, woody base.

perfumes.name: Turathi Purple

perfumes.name: Turathi Red
perfumes.description: Rose, musk and floral notes open soft, wood, rose and jasmine build the heart, and apricot, musk and peony close clean and light.

perfumes.name: Violet Bouquet
perfumes.description: Saffron and bergamot sit above a sweet heart of caramel, amber and orange, resting on oakmoss and ambergris.

perfumes.name: Abia Noir
perfumes.description: A dark spice and leather blend: cardamom and pink pepper over saffron and violet, resting on patchouli, leather and cashmeran.

perfumes.name: Alf Laila O Laila
perfumes.description: A rich, ornate blend: saffron, raspberry and rose over a base of amber, oud and musk.
