perfumes.description: A warm, simple pairing of amber and musk, brightened by a rose opening and rounded off with cedar.

perfumes.name: Amber Santal
perfumes.description: A dry woody-resinous scent: cypress, pepper and nutmeg open to sandalwood and incense, then patchouli, amber and cedar.

perfumes.name: Aurum
perfumes.description: Fruity-floral and golden: raspberry and citrus open to orange blossom, jasmine and saffron, with a honeyed base of musk, amber, sandalwood and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Aurum Elixir
perfumes.description: A fruity-sweet gourmand: bergamot, blackcurrant and strawberry over patchouli and vanilla, with jasmine, cashmere wood and caramel below.

perfumes.name: Chapter 1 By Maxime Exler
perfumes.description: A warm woody take with fruit: cardamom and amber open onto cashmere wood, sandalwood and white musks, with fig, cypriol and patchouli underneath.

perfumes.name: Chapter 4 By Nathalie Lorson
perfumes.description: Incense and pepper over leather and woods, finishing in a darker, sweeter base of cherry, caramel and davana.

perfumes.name: Cherry Wood
perfumes.description: Sweet fruit on a woody frame: raspberry, lychee and cherry over frangipani and frankincense, with leather and cashmere wood below.

perfumes.name: Evoke Red Edition Her
perfumes.description: A sweet, creamy blend: iris, popcorn and pink pepper over magnolia and macadamia, drying down to sandalwood, musk and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Evoke Red Edition Him
perfumes.description: Sweet and spicy with an herbal edge: pink pepper, strawberry and cinnamon over sage, caramel and lavender, on benzoin, labdanum and tonka bean.

perfumes.name: Evoke Silver Edition Her
perfumes.description: A polished, powdery floral: aldehydes and bergamot lift iris, ylang-ylang and rose, settling on amber, benzoin, musk and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Kuro
perfumes.description: Green and aromatic with a deep base: geranium and bergamot, lavender, pepper and elemi, then ambergris, patchouli and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Neutron
perfumes.description: Clean and herbal: artemisia, lemon and rosemary over musk, carnation and geranium, ending in oakmoss and cedar.

perfumes.name: Oud Mist
perfumes.description: A smooth, warm oud style: cardamom and pepper over osmanthus and leather, finishing on cypriol, amber and cashmere wood.

perfumes.name: Raindrops
perfumes.description: A citrus-and-flower blend: bergamot, mandarin and orange over rose, ylang-ylang and jasmine, finishing with musk, amber and styrax.

perfumes.name: Sacred Love
perfumes.description: A fruity floral with woody depth: blackcurrant and lily open to peach and jasmine, ending in vetiver, amber and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Decision
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, bergamot and cardamom open bright and spiced. Frankincense, juniper and myrrh give a resinous heart, while patchouli, cedarwood and vanilla end warm and woody.

perfumes.name: Epic 56 Woman
perfumes.description: Cumin, pink pepper and cinnamon open warm and spiced. Rose, geranium and tea shape the heart, and amber, oud, frankincense, sandalwood and vanilla make a rich, woody base.

perfumes.name: Epic Woman
perfumes.description: Rose and jasmine sit over spiced cumin and cinnamon, with a touch of tea. Oud, frankincense, sandalwood, patchouli and vanilla give a dense, warm, floral base.

perfumes.name: Guidance 46
perfumes.description: Pear, hazelnut, rose and almond open with a sweet, spiced glow. Saffron and jasmine sambac lead down to sandalwood, labdanum and vanilla, floral and deeply warm.

perfumes.name: Honour 43 Woman
perfumes.description: Rhubarb, pepper and coriander open sharp, then jasmine, tuberose, gardenia and carnation fill the heart. Sandalwood, labdanum, leather and frankincense finish creamy and resinous.

perfumes.name: Interlude 53 Man
perfumes.description: Bergamot, oregano and pimento open with a herbal bite. Amber, frankincense and labdanum make a resinous heart, and leather, oud and patchouli leave a smoky, deep base.

perfumes.name: Interlude Black Iris
perfumes.description: Violet, rosemary and bergamot open crisp, iris and myrrh form a powdery, resinous heart, and leather, oud, sandalwood and cedarwood give a dry, smoky base.

perfumes.name: Jubilation XXV Man
perfumes.description: A rich, resinous scent with a fruity, spicy start of orange, blackberry and coriander, a honeyed heart with clove and rose, and a deep base of oud, myrrh, moss and ambergris.

perfumes.name: Lilac Love
perfumes.description: Lilac, peony and gardenia are soft and powdery, with iris and chocolate in the middle. Vanilla, patchouli and sandalwood bring sweetness and warmth.

perfumes.name: Lineage
perfumes.description: Ginger, Sichuan pepper and saffron open sharp and bright. Frankincense, fenugreek and myrrh fill the heart, and vetiver, patchouli, benzoin and labdanum make it earthy and resinous.

perfumes.name: Love Delight
perfumes.description: Ginger, mandarin and cinnamon spice up a rose-led opening. Heliotrope and jasmine sweeten the heart, and vanilla, chocolate, rum and cypriol leave a warm, dessert-like base.

perfumes.name: Love Hibiscus
perfumes.description: Caramel and passion fruit give a sweet, juicy opening, lifted by bergamot. Hibiscus, iris and frankincense follow, and sandalwood, cypriol and vanilla make it soft and powdery.

perfumes.name: Opus XV King Blue
perfumes.description: Mandarin, blackcurrant and pink pepper open lightly. Frankincense and amber bring a resinous heart, and sandalwood, oakwood, patchouli, oud and leather make a deep, woody base.

perfumes.name: Overture Woman
perfumes.description: Bergamot, saffron and apple open bright and slightly spiced. Rose, geranium and cinnamon fill the heart, and incense, labdanum and leather leave a warm, resinous trail.

perfumes.name: Reflection Woman
perfumes.description: Violet and green leaves open cool, then magnolia, ylang-ylang and jasmine bloom softly over cedarwood, sandalwood and musk.

perfumes.name: Search
perfumes.description: Lemon, lime and mandarin give a bright citrus start. Frankincense, pepper and elemi bring a resinous heart, and cade, vetiver and guaiac wood leave a smoky, earthy finish.

perfumes.name: Ari
perfumes.description: Pear and raspberry open juicy and light, then lily of the valley, rose and orchid make a soft floral heart. Musk, woody notes and marshmallow leave a sweet, airy finish.

perfumes.name: God Is A Woman
perfumes.description: Pear and ambrette open soft and slightly musky, with iris and Turkish rose forming a powdery heart. Vanilla and sandalwood close it, sweet, warm and gently creamy.

perfumes.name: Moonlight
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant and plum brighten a heart of marshmallow and peony. Amber, sandalwood and vanilla keep the drydown soft and warm.

perfumes.name: Amber Arabia Oud
perfumes.description: Saffron, nutmeg and orange start spicy and bright, then marigold and lavender lead down to patchouli, oud and ambroxan. Warm with an herbal freshness.

perfumes.name: Art D' Amour pour Femme
perfumes.description: Juicy lychee, pear and citrus open onto rose and jasmine, then fade into vanilla, patchouli and tonka bean. Fruity, floral and sweet.

perfumes.name: Aura
perfumes.description: Apple, cardamom and lemon give a crisp start. Violet and iris add a powdery softness, while sandalwood and vetiver ground it in a warm, spiced finish.

perfumes.name: Aura Fresh
perfumes.description: Lemon, bergamot and cardamom sparkle over pepper and sage, resting on cedarwood, saffron and amber. Fresh, spiced and quietly warm.

perfumes.name: Beau Acute Men
perfumes.description: Lemon, orange and petitgrain meet an herbal heart of lavender, sage and rosemary, softened by jasmine and rose, over cedarwood and vetiver. Clean and green.

perfumes.name: Black Saffron
perfumes.description: Lavender and ginger lead to a sweet, earthy middle of patchouli, vanilla and tonka bean. Amber, sandalwood and vetiver keep it warm and soft.

perfumes.name: Blue Homme
perfumes.description: Bergamot, lime and neroli make a bright citrus start, with lavender and rosemary beneath it. Cedarwood, vanilla and oakmoss close it gently.

perfumes.name: Blue Sky

perfumes.name: Bucephalus No. IX

perfumes.description: Lemon, bergamot and coriander give a clean, peppery start. Violet leaf and lily of the valley add green florals before patchouli, ambergris and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Tag Him Uomo Rosso
perfumes.description: Lavender and cardamom give a herbal, spiced start, pepper runs through the middle, and incense, patchouli, vanilla and tonka bean turn it sweet and warm.

perfumes.name: The Lion's Club Majestueux
perfumes.description: Cinnamon and pepper spark a smoky heart of tobacco, incense and labdanum, with osmanthus adding a touch of fruit. Vanilla, cedarwood and vetiver keep it earthy.

perfumes.name: The Pride of Armaf Admiral
perfumes.description: Cardamom and pink pepper open over lavender and incense. The base is warm and sweet, with vanilla, tonka bean, amber and patchouli.

perfumes.name: The Pride of Armaf pour Femme
perfumes.description: Mandarin, jasmine and orange blossom brighten a gourmand centre of almond and coffee. Tonka bean, chocolate and patchouli leave a creamy sweetness.

perfumes.name: The Pride of Armaf pour Homme
perfumes.description: Bergamot, lemon and verbena open zesty, cinnamon and nutmeg warm the middle with a trace of oakmoss, and sandalwood, vanilla and tonka bean round it off.

perfumes.name: The Pride of Armaf Rose Oud
perfumes.description: Tropical and sweet: lemon, mandarin, pineapple and lychee over orange blossom, orchid and coconut, resting on a soft base of vanilla, musk and amber.

perfumes.name: The Warrior Man
perfumes.description: Citrus and pink pepper meet vetiver, then cedarwood, grapefruit and labdanum add dry warmth. Frankincense, ginger and sandalwood leave a resinous, woody trail.

perfumes.name: Tres Nuit Lyric Man
perfumes.description: Bergamot, mandarin and an aquatic accord start fresh and clean. Patchouli, musk and amber warm the heart, while rosemary, lavender and cypress give a green, earthy base.

perfumes.name: Tres Nuit Valentina
perfumes.description: Lychee and pear brighten bergamot, rose and geranium form the floral centre, and incense, vanilla, amber and woody notes give the base a resinous glow.

perfumes.name: Uniq Effects of Uniq
perfumes.description: Pear and mandarin open juicy, vanilla and orange blossom bloom in the heart, and coffee, caramel, cedarwood, patchouli and musk make a warm, sweet base.

perfumes.name: Uniq Oud Forever
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, bergamot, cardamom and saffron open spiced and bright, cypriol, osmanthus and jasmine bloom in the heart, and ambroxan, patchouli, cashmeran and Ambrocenide leave a warm, earthy base.

perfumes.name: Vanity Femme Essence Woman
perfumes.description: Freesia, orange blossom and peach start soft and juicy. Jasmine, magnolia and rose build a creamy floral heart over amber, musk and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Venetian Ambre Edition Man
perfumes.description: Marigold and pepper open onto creamy tuberose and orange blossom. Vanilla, patchouli, vetiver and amber give a warm, earthy base.

perfumes.name: Venetian Girl Edition Rouge Red
perfumes.description: Tuberose and orange blossom, creamy and rich, follow a peppery marigold opening. Vanilla, patchouli, vetiver and amber give it an earthy, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Venetian Girl From Venice With Love
perfumes.description: Lychee meets rose over musk, giving a fruity, floral and clean mix.

perfumes.name: Venetian Gold
perfumes.description: Rose, fruit and cashmeran: a floral start, a fruity heart and a soft, woody base.

perfumes.name: Venetian Man
perfumes.description: Petitgrain, orange and cardamom open bright, lavender and lily of the valley lend a clean floral heart, and vetiver, oakmoss and musk keep it earthy.

perfumes.name: Venice Noir Woman
perfumes.description: Citrus and orange blossom lead to a creamy heart of magnolia and honeysuckle with a hint of pink pepper. Amber, vanilla, musk and cashmere wood end it soft.

perfumes.name: Ventana Marine
perfumes.description: Petitgrain gives a bitter-green start, ginger adds spice, and rosewood leaves a woody base.

perfumes.name: Victory Man
perfumes.description: Orange, pear and cardamom make a juicy, spiced start. Lavender and pink pepper carry through, and patchouli and vetiver add an earthy, fresh finish.

perfumes.name: Voyage Bleu Man
perfumes.description: Bergamot, grapefruit and lemon with pink pepper sparkle at the start. Mint, nutmeg and ginger lead to a dry base of cedarwood, patchouli, sandalwood and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Voyage Brown Man
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, sage and cardamom open with a cool iris edge. Violet leaf, cinnamon and lavender follow, and tonka bean and woody notes warm the finish.

perfumes.name: Voyage Titan pour Homme
perfumes.description: Bergamot, pink pepper and cardamom open, jasmine, lavender and incense run through the heart, and oud, tobacco, sandalwood and vanilla deepen into a resinous base.

perfumes.name: Yum Yum
perfumes.description: Cherry, wild berries, bergamot and orange start bright and juicy, vanilla, white flowers and rose make a soft heart, and powdery notes, amber and musk close sweet.

perfumes.name: Acqua di Giò Eau de Toilette
perfumes.description: A marine freshness of sea notes and citrus, with jasmine, rosemary and freesia in the heart. Musk, cedarwood, oakmoss and amber finish clean and soft.

perfumes.name: Acqua di Giò Elixir
perfumes.description: An aquatic accord and violet sit under a bright bergamot and mandarin top. Patchouli and leather add a faint, dark, salty depth beneath the freshness.

perfumes.name: Acqua di Gio Parfum
perfumes.description: Bergamot and rosemary give a clean, herbal brightness over a dry woody backbone. Fresh and citrusy with some depth.

perfumes.name: Acqua Di Giò Profondo
perfumes.description: Sea notes and cypress give a deep, salty, green freshness, resting on soft musk. Cool and clean, like wind off dark water.

perfumes.name: Armani Code Absolu
perfumes.description: Ginger and neroli open lightly spiced. Jasmine, orange blossom and tuberose form a creamy white floral heart, and tonka bean and vanilla leave it sweet and smooth.

perfumes.name: Armani Code Eau de Toilette
perfumes.description: A clean lavandin heart, brightened by mandarin. Tonka bean and cedarwood add a sweet, woody softness at the base.

perfumes.name: Blanc Kogane
perfumes.description: Aldehydes, lemon and pink pepper give a crisp, airy start. Jasmine and ylang-ylang soften the heart, and musk, vetiver and patchouli make the base clean and earthy.

perfumes.name: Emporio Armani Because It's You
perfumes.description: Raspberry, neroli and lemon open juicy and bright. Rose sits at the centre, and vanilla, musk and amberwood leave a soft, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely
perfumes.description: Rum opens boozy and warm, lavender gives a herbal heart, and cedarwood with vanilla leaves a sweet, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely
perfumes.description: Pink pepper and juniper open sharp, lavender, cinnamon and sage add herbal spice, and vanilla, tonka bean and chestnut make a sweet, nutty base.

perfumes.name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Parfum
perfumes.description: Mandarin and pink pepper brighten a herbal heart of lavender and sage. Chestnut and vanilla give the base a sweet, toasted softness.

perfumes.name: I Will
perfumes.description: Bergamot opens clean, vanilla adds a rounded sweetness, and leather gives a faintly smoky edge. Warm and quietly sweet.

perfumes.name: My Way Intense
perfumes.description: Orange blossom and bergamot open bright, tuberose and jasmine make a creamy white floral heart, and cedarwood, vanilla and musk end soft and smooth.

perfumes.name: My Way Ylang
perfumes.description: Mango, coconut, orange blossom and bergamot open sunny and tropical. Ylang-ylang and tuberose make a creamy heart, and musk, vanilla and cedarwood end soft.

perfumes.name: Stronger With You Absolutely
perfumes.description: Boozy rum and aromatic lavender over a base of cedarwood and vanilla. Sweet, warm and woody, with a smooth finish.

perfumes.name: Stronger With You
perfumes.description: Cardamom, pink pepper, violet leaf and mint open crisp. Sage, melon and pineapple add a juicy heart, and vanilla, chestnut, cedarwood and amberwood end sweet and warm.

perfumes.name: Iris Fauve
perfumes.description: Iris, bergamot and cinnamon meet earthy patchouli and vetiver, and the base turns resinous with myrrh, labdanum and musk.

perfumes.name: Lune Feline
perfumes.description: Cinnamon, cardamom and pink pepper open warm and bright, with cedarwood, ambergris and styrax in a smoky heart. Vanilla, balsam of Peru and musk finish it rich and resinous.

perfumes.name: Pink Me Up
perfumes.description: Bergamot and orange blossom open sparkling, with champagne, rose and blackberry making a bubbly, fruity heart. Patchouli, iris and musk give the base a soft, powdery finish.

perfumes.name: Riviera Lazuli
perfumes.description: Lemon, cypress and bergamot give a clear start, followed by clary sage and cedarwood, with immortelle, fir balsam and incense below.

perfumes.name: Riviera Sunrise
perfumes.description: Lemon, mandarin and orange open sun-bright, then fig, basil and orange blossom give the heart a green, juicy softness. Vetiver, cedarwood and musk make a clean, woody base.

perfumes.name: Gold Fair in Mayfair
perfumes.description: Absinthe and nutmeg open herbal and spiced, with chocolate, sage and iris at the centre. Ambroxan, styrax and vetiver close it, a warm, powdery scent with a green edge.

perfumes.name: Mint Tonic
perfumes.description: Mint, lime and grapefruit make a cool, zesty start, with ginger and geranium adding a spiced, floral heart. Musk, vetiver and cedarwood leave a clean, dry finish.

perfumes.name: Oud Save The King
perfumes.description: Tea and bergamot open crisp, with suede and iris giving the heart a powdery, smoky softness. Sandalwood and oud close it, creamy and dark beneath the freshness.

perfumes.name: Oud Save The Queen
perfumes.description: Tea, clove and bergamot open bright, then jasmine and orange blossom make a creamy, floral heart. Oud, tonka bean and guaiac wood leave a warm, smoky base.

perfumes.name: Rose in Wonderland
perfumes.description: Rose and blackcurrant open fruity and bright, with geranium adding a green, floral heart. Vetiver and amber give the base an earthy, golden warmth.

perfumes.name: Shine Despite Everything
perfumes.description: Pimento, frankincense and turmeric open warm and spiced, then caramel, rose and iris sweeten the heart. Coumarin, vanilla and akigalawood leave a soft, glowing, woody base.

perfumes.name: The Other Side of Oud
perfumes.description: Ginger, cinnamon and cardamom open warm and spiced, with geranium and roasted coffee at the heart. Vanilla and oud finish it dark and sweet, the coffee echoing through the base.

perfumes.name: Azzaro Pour Elle
perfumes.description: Cardamom, champagne and orange sparkle over rose, lily and peach. Frankincense, cashmere wood, sandalwood and vanilla bring a smooth, woody-sweet base.

perfumes.name: Azzaro Pour Homme
perfumes.description: An aromatic, herbal classic: lavender, sage, basil and anise over bergamot, with cardamom and sandalwood in the heart. Leather, tonka bean and oakmoss give a dry, earthy base.

perfumes.name: Chrome Legend
perfumes.description: Tea, mint and orange make a cool, watery opening, with oakmoss and musk running through the heart. Cedarwood and vetiver close it dry and earthy, still crisp throughout.

perfumes.name: Chrome
perfumes.description: Bergamot is clean and sparkling over a clear heart of musk. A green touch of maté in the base keeps the finish fresh, light and skin-close.

perfumes.name: Forever Wanted Elixir
perfumes.description: Raspberry, mandarin and bergamot brighten clary sage, lavandin and cardamom. Leather, vetiver and wolfwood anchor the base. Herbal, fresh and lightly spiced.

perfumes.name: The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense
perfumes.description: Cardamom adds a bright spice at the start, then caramel turns the heart sweet and glossy. Amberwood closes it warm and dry, balancing the sugar with a woody glow.

perfumes.name: Wanted Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Juniper opens crisp and gin-like, with sage adding a herbal, slightly savoury heart. Vetiver dries the finish into something earthy and green.

perfumes.name: Blanc Galaxie
perfumes.description: Cedrat, mandarin, lime and petitgrain make a bright, bitter citrus opening, with myrtle, magnolia and cardamom adding green, floral spice. Patchouli lends the finish an earthy depth.

perfumes.name: Bleu Infini
perfumes.description: Pink pepper and clary sage open sharp, while labdanum and lichen add a mossy, resinous warmth. Akigalawood and oakmoss ground it, a dry, earthy and herbal scent.

perfumes.name: Cuir Elysees
perfumes.description: Leather and raspberry open together, dark and fruity, with pink pepper adding a bright spice. Jasmine and sandalwood soften the heart, leaving a creamy, floral-woody trail.

perfumes.name: Ebene
perfumes.description: Ebony wood leads, dry and dark, with myrrh, incense and tobacco adding resinous smoke. Geranium lifts the heart with a green floral touch, while cedarwood keeps the finish clean.

perfumes.name: Azure
perfumes.description: Crisp and herbal, with lemon and mandarin over lavender and clary sage, finishing on smooth tonka bean and a clean, woody base.

perfumes.name: For Men Intense
perfumes.description: Frankincense and pepper open into leather, labdanum and clary sage. Cedarwood, patchouli and sandalwood give a dark, resinous base.

perfumes.name: Silverlake
perfumes.description: Mint and lemon feel cool and green, with violet leaf, pink pepper and lavender in the middle. Musk and amberwood leave a fresh, herbal finish with a little spice.

perfumes.name: Heat
perfumes.description: Peach, magnolia and neroli open lush, then almond, honeysuckle and musk warm the heart. Amber, tonka bean and wood close it sweetly.

perfumes.name: Heat Rush
perfumes.description: Cherry, passion fruit and blood orange give a juicy, tropical start before hibiscus and mango soften into amber, musk and teak. Bright fruit over a light woody base.

perfumes.name: Aqua Sapphire
perfumes.description: Davana, rum, saffron and pineapple open sweet and spiced, with rose, algae and musk in a salty heart. Amber, oakmoss, sandalwood, vanilla and cypriol give a deep, mossy finish.

perfumes.name: Blue Sapphire
perfumes.description: Lemon, orange, marigold, saffron and sage open bright and herbal, followed by cardamom, magnolia, rose and jasmine. Amber, oud, patchouli and vetiver make a rich, earthy base.

perfumes.name: Bodacious
perfumes.description: Cherry, clove, almond and cognac open boozy and sweet, with jasmine sambac, heliotrope and rose in the heart. Tonka bean, amber, vanilla and tobacco leave a warm, powdery trail.

perfumes.name: Defender
perfumes.description: Cognac, ginger, honey and liquorice open rich and sweet, with jasmine, myrrh and orange blossom in the heart. Labdanum, leather and amber give the base a deep, resinous warmth.

perfumes.name: Empire
perfumes.description: Peach, plum, mandarin and pink pepper open juicy, then gardenia, magnolia, rose and jasmine sambac bloom. Sandalwood, vanilla, patchouli and raspberry keep the base creamy and sweet.

perfumes.name: Monarch
perfumes.description: Bergamot, grapefruit, tea and cypress open crisp, with rose, jasmine, cinnamon and cardamom in a spiced floral heart. Leather, oakmoss, labdanum, vanilla and oud make a layered, resinous base.

perfumes.name: Brooklyn
perfumes.description: Grapefruit and cardamom open a cool green heart of cypress, geranium and juniper. Cedarwood, leather and guaiac wood ground it with dry warmth.

perfumes.name: Brit
perfumes.description: Pear and lime give a juicy start, with almond running sweet through the heart. Amber and vanilla settle underneath, warm and soft, with a faint woodiness from mahogany.

perfumes.name: Goddess
perfumes.description: Vanilla and lavender meet an unexpected salty note of caviar in the heart. It is sweet and creamy, with a briny edge that keeps the warmth from turning heavy.

perfumes.name: Hero Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Resinous and woody, with a cool pine needle top that gives way to the balm of benzoin. Cedarwood rounds out the base, leaving a green, warm and quietly smoky finish.

perfumes.name: Hero Eau de Toilette
perfumes.description: Bergamot is bright and clean over a heart of cedarwood. Pepper and juniper in the base add a dry, herbal sharpness, keeping the whole scent fresh and woody.

perfumes.name: Hero Parfum
perfumes.description: Cypress opens green and cool, with amyris adding a smooth, dry wood in the heart. Cedarwood closes it, a fresh, quiet woody scent with an outdoor feel.

perfumes.name: London
perfumes.description: Rose, mandarin and honeysuckle open lightly, with jasmine, peony and gardenia opening into a creamy floral heart. Patchouli, musk and sandalwood give it a soft, warm finish.

perfumes.name: My Burberry
perfumes.description: Sweet pea and a squeeze of citrus open bright, then geranium, freesia and juicy peach flow into the heart. Patchouli, rose, violet and musk leave a soft, fresh floral trail.

perfumes.name: My Burberry Blush
perfumes.description: Lemon and pomegranate sparkle on top, with rose, apple and geranium forming a juicy, rosy heart. Jasmine and wisteria close it soft, a light floral that stays fresh and fruity.

perfumes.name: Touch
perfumes.description: Violet leaf, mandarin and artemisia start crisp, then cedarwood, pepper and nutmeg add spice. Musk, vetiver and tonka bean leave a soft, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Allegra Baciami
perfumes.description: Gardenia opens creamy, vanilla warms the heart, and amber closes sweet and soft.

perfumes.name: Allegra Chill & Sole
perfumes.description: Lemon brightens the opening, then neroli gives a soft, creamy white-floral heart. Petitgrain keeps the finish green and clean, a light, sunlit citrus with a gentle bloom running through it.

perfumes.name: Eau Parfumee the Imperial
perfumes.description: Crisp citrus and a calm, green tea accord sit over a quiet bed of musk. It reads fresh and airy, cool rather than sweet, and stays soft all the way down.

perfumes.name: Le Gemme Gyan
perfumes.description: Orange opens bright before jasmine sambac turns the heart creamy and floral. Patchouli grounds it with an earthy, slightly dark base, so the sunny start settles into something rounder.

perfumes.name: Le Gemme Kobraa
perfumes.description: Geranium opens green and floral, then incense drifts in with a smoky, resinous warmth. Oud closes it richly, giving a dense, glowing base beneath the petals.

perfumes.name: Le Gemme Tygar
perfumes.description: Grapefruit gives a sharp, sparkling start, and ginger adds a warm, spicy lift. Ambroxan finishes in a smooth amber glow, so the citrus fades into something warm and mineral.

perfumes.name: Man Glacial Essence
perfumes.description: Juniper and ginger give a cold, spiced start. Iris and sandalwood turn powdery in the middle, finishing on dry cedarwood and musk.

perfumes.name: Man In Black
perfumes.description: Spice and rum give a warm start, tuberose and leather make a smoky floral centre, and benzoin with guaiac wood closes it.

perfumes.name: Man Wood Essence
perfumes.description: Coriander and citrus open fresh, with cypress and vetiver forming a green, earthy centre. Benzoin and cedarwood bring a gentle, resinous warmth to the end.

perfumes.name: Alto Astral
perfumes.description: Aldehydes and coconut open with a creamy shimmer, followed by incense, jasmine and musk. Sandalwood, cashmere wood and amber leave it warm and smooth.

perfumes.name: Animalique
perfumes.description: A heart of suede, violet and mimosa sits under bright bergamot and lemon. Amber, sandalwood and tobacco give it a warm, smoky, powdery depth.

perfumes.name: De Los Santos
perfumes.description: Clary sage and plum begin dry and slightly fruity, followed by powdery iris and resinous labdanum. Musk, ambroxan and palo santo leave it smooth and warm.

perfumes.name: Future Memories
perfumes.description: Galbanum, blackcurrant and aldehydes sharpen the opening, then iris and orange blossom turn powdery. Vanilla, musk and ambrofix leave a sweet, warm trail.

perfumes.name: Havana Tonka
perfumes.description: Bergamot, rum, pink pepper and creme brulee open sweet and boozy. Tobacco, violet and suede add smoky depth before musk, tonka bean, patchouli and benzoin warm the base.

perfumes.name: Mojave Ghost Absolu de Parfum
perfumes.description: Naseberry, ambrette and pear give a soft, fruity start. Magnolia, sandalwood and violet bloom in the heart, and cedarwood, musk, amber and vetiver finish woody and smooth.

perfumes.name: Mumbai Noise
perfumes.description: Davana's herbal sweetness leads into tonka bean and coffee, settling on oud, sandalwood and labdanum. Warm, resinous and softly sweet.

perfumes.name: Beauty
perfumes.description: Ambrette, jasmine and cedarwood, kept simple. A soft musky floral over clean, creamy wood that stays close and quiet.

perfumes.name: CK One
perfumes.description: A bright burst of pineapple, mandarin and bergamot opens it, with violet, iris and jasmine in a light floral heart. Sandalwood, musk and oakmoss leave a clean, airy, slightly powdery finish.

perfumes.name: Defy
perfumes.description: Bergamot opens bright over a heart of vetiver, earthy and dry. Amber warms the base, so the citrus slowly gives way to a grounded, gently golden finish.

perfumes.name: Escape
perfumes.description: Hyacinth, apple, mandarin and blackcurrant make a juicy, green opening, followed by peach, jasmine and rose. Musk, sandalwood and vanilla close it warm, with a mossy undertone.

perfumes.name: Eternity for Men
perfumes.description: Mandarin, lavender and green leaves feel crisp and herbal, with basil and sage in the middle and a woody base of sandalwood and amber.

perfumes.name: Eternity Moment
perfumes.description: Guava, lychee, raspberry and melon open juicy, then passion flower, peony and water lily bloom. Rosewood, sandalwood and musk finish soft and clean.

perfumes.name: Eternity
perfumes.description: A soft bouquet of lily of the valley, jasmine, rose and violet with a powdery sheen. Freesia and mandarin brighten the start, while amber and sandalwood keep the finish gentle.

perfumes.name: Euphoria Men
perfumes.description: Ginger and pepper start sharp, giving way to cedarwood, basil and sage. Suede, patchouli, amber and rosewood form a dry, spiced and woody base.

perfumes.name: My Euphoria
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant sweetness leads to orchid and tuberose, with a green touch of bamboo and a deep base of oud and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: 212 VIP Men
perfumes.description: Caviar, lime and mint open cool and salty, vodka and ginger add a spiced heart, and amber, musk and kingwood leave a warm, smooth finish.

perfumes.name: 212 VIP Rosé
perfumes.description: Rose and pink pepper start lively, then peach turns the heart soft and juicy, finishing on clean musk.

perfumes.name: Bad Boy Extreme
perfumes.description: Sage and ginger open sharp, then vetiver and chocolate turn it earthy and sweet, with tonka bean and patchouli underneath.

perfumes.name: Chic
perfumes.description: Melon and bergamot open juicy, while cinnamon and cardamom warm the middle. Cedarwood and tonka bean finish it, spicy and smooth.

perfumes.name: Good Girl
perfumes.description: Almond and jasmine sambac meet tuberose, then drift into tonka bean and chocolate. Creamy, floral and sweet.

perfumes.name: Very Good Girl Elixir
perfumes.description: Cherry and almond open sweet and rich, tuberose and rose make a creamy floral heart, and vanilla with chocolate gives a warm, dessert-like finish.

perfumes.name: Cartier Roadster
perfumes.description: Bergamot and sea notes open bright and airy, followed by cool mint and patchouli. Wood and vanilla settle underneath. A fresh, herbal scent with an earthy base.

perfumes.name: Must de Cartier
perfumes.description: A big floral chypre with a powdery shimmer: aldehydes and mandarin open it, rose, iris and jasmine fill the heart, and amber, vanilla and sandalwood close it creamy and warm.

perfumes.name: Chloé Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Peony, freesia and lychee open light and juicy, magnolia, lily of the valley and rose form the heart, and cedarwood, amber and honey close warm and sweet.

perfumes.name: Chloé Rose Tangerine
perfumes.description: Mandarin and blackcurrant open juicy, rose forms the floral heart, and cedarwood and amber leave a warm, woody close.

perfumes.name: Nomade Jasmin Naturel Intense
perfumes.description: Jasmine opens creamy, dates sweeten the heart, and patchouli leaves an earthy, dark base.

perfumes.name: Aromatics Elixir
perfumes.description: Green sage and verbena give way to a rich floral heart of rose and tuberose, anchored by mossy, earthy patchouli and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Happy
perfumes.description: Grapefruit and mandarin burst open above magnolia, lily and orchid. Honeysuckle and lily of the valley keep the finish airy and creamy.

perfumes.name: Happy for Men
perfumes.description: Lime, mandarin and lemon bring a clean citrus snap, with freesia, jasmine and sea notes beneath. Cypress, musk and cedarwood settle the base.

perfumes.name: 1872 for Women
perfumes.description: A bright mix of lemon, pineapple, mandarin and blueberry opens it, followed by rose, freesia, orchid and jasmine. Sandalwood, patchouli, musk and oakmoss close it soft and woody.

perfumes.name: 1872 Masculine
perfumes.description: Rosemary, pepper, nutmeg and citrus open aromatic and spicy, with freesia, clary sage and jasmine in the heart. Cedarwood, sandalwood, patchouli and resins give a dry, warm base.

perfumes.name: 20 Iconic Masculine
perfumes.description: Built on petitgrain, mandarin and yuzu, bright and slightly bitter, with pink pepper and rosemary adding a herbal spice. Cedarwood gives the finish a clean, dry backbone.

perfumes.name: Blonde Amber
perfumes.description: Bergamot, bitter orange, rum and ginger open warm and boozy, then iris, jasmine, tuberose and saffron deepen the heart. Labdanum, vanilla, tonka bean and myrrh make a golden, resinous base.

perfumes.name: C Woody Leather
perfumes.description: Mandarin opens briefly before tobacco and saffron bring a warm, smoky spice. Leather and oud close it, dark and dry, with a woody depth that lingers quietly.

perfumes.name: Crab Apple Blossom
perfumes.description: Apple blossom opens crisp and green, and rhubarb and mint keep the heart cool and tart. A touch of sugar softens it, while sandalwood gives the base a creamy, quiet finish.

perfumes.name: Jump Up and Kiss Me Hedonistic
perfumes.description: Bergamot, grapefruit and neroli open sparkling, with cherry, maté and clary sage in a green, juicy heart. Amber, leather, labdanum and vanilla warm the base, soft and resinous.

perfumes.name: No 1 Clive Christian for Men
perfumes.description: Nutmeg and thyme open aromatic over a bright heart of bergamot, lime, grapefruit and cardamom. Sandalwood, tonka bean, amber and vanilla make a warm, smooth base beneath the citrus.

perfumes.name: Rock Rose
perfumes.description: Bright orange and bergamot with a touch of pepper give way to lavender, violet and clary sage over labdanum, ending in a quiet thread of saffron.

perfumes.name: X for Women
perfumes.description: Bergamot, rhubarb, peach and mandarin open juicy, then rose, jasmine, iris and tuberose bloom into a full bouquet. Vanilla, rum, patchouli and sandalwood leave a sweet, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Coach Blue
perfumes.description: Absinthe and lime open sharply, then sea notes and pepper add a salty, spiced coolness. Amber and cedarwood finish it warm and dry.

perfumes.name: Coach Dreams
perfumes.description: Bitter orange and pear lead to gardenia and a green, cool cactus note. The base is soft woody notes and ambroxan.

perfumes.name: Coach For Men
perfumes.description: Pear, bergamot and kumquat sit over cardamom, coriander and geranium. Vetiver, suede and ambergris give the base a smooth, dry depth.

perfumes.name: Coach Love
perfumes.description: Simple and soft, it moves from strawberry through rose into a quiet base of cedarwood.

perfumes.name: Absolu Aventus
perfumes.description: Crisp ginger, grapefruit and bergamot lead, then cardamom, cinnamon and pineapple add spice and juice. Labdanum, vetiver and patchouli ground it in earthy warmth.

perfumes.name: Acqua Fiorentina
perfumes.description: Plum and apple open juicy and fruity, with rose and carnation blooming at the heart. Bergamot, lemon, cedarwood and sandalwood keep it clear and fresh.

perfumes.name: Carmina
perfumes.description: Cherry, saffron and pink pepper brighten the opening before rose, violet and peony bloom. Frankincense, myrrh, amber and musk give a warm, resinous depth.

perfumes.name: Centaurus
perfumes.description: Cardamom, cinnamon and tobacco open spicy, geranium and heliotrope bring a floral sweetness, and benzoin, tonka bean and vanilla fill the base with warm, balsamic richness.

perfumes.name: Delphinus
perfumes.description: Incense, almond and pink pepper open warm and spicy, with heliotrope and iris giving a powdery heart. Patchouli, tonka bean, leather and vanilla finish deep and sweet.

perfumes.name: Eladaria
perfumes.description: Sparkling mandarin, bergamot and pink pepper lead to rose and peony with a powdery softness. Musk, vanilla and cashmere wood leave it smooth and gentle.

perfumes.name: Fleurissimo
perfumes.description: Clear, green violet leaf and bergamot open the way. Rose, tuberose and ylang-ylang bloom creamily at the heart, with iris and ambergris giving a soft, polished base.

perfumes.name: Iris Debonair
perfumes.description: Absinthe and cardamom give a sharp, herbal opening beside bergamot. Lavender, violet leaf and fig lead to a powdery iris base held by ambrette.

perfumes.name: Jardin d'Amalfi
perfumes.description: Sunlit bergamot and lemon over vetiver and sandalwood, with a dry touch of pepper. Ambergris and musk give the woody citrus a warm, quiet base.

perfumes.name: Love In Black
perfumes.description: Jasmine, violet and cedarwood open soft and powdery, iris and clove add a hint of spice, and blackcurrant, rose and musk leave a dark, smooth finish.

perfumes.name: Love in White for Summer
perfumes.description: Rose, bergamot and magnolia open airy. Iris, basmati rice and cedarwood create a powdery, woody heart, and ambergris with sandalwood end it warm and softly sweet.

perfumes.name: Neroli Sauvage
perfumes.description: A bright citrus burst of bergamot, bitter orange, grapefruit and lemon, with neroli and verbena. Orange blossom and ambergris leave a soft, creamy finish.

perfumes.name: Original Santal
perfumes.description: Coriander, juniper and cinnamon meet creamy sandalwood, with lavender, petitgrain and rosemary adding a herbal freshness. Vanilla and tonka bean warm the base.

perfumes.name: Oud Zarian
perfumes.description: Bergamot, ginger and frankincense open a spiced, resinous scene around rose. Oud, sandalwood and myrrh sit underneath, sweetened by tonka bean and liquorice.

perfumes.name: Pure White Cologne
perfumes.description: Clean citrus from bergamot, lemon and grapefruit meets green galbanum and soft pear. Ambergris, musk and rice powder leave a fresh, airy, slightly powdery trail.

perfumes.name: Queen of Silk
perfumes.description: Osmanthus, magnolia and saffron open golden. Tuberose, passion fruit and a trace of oud add fruit and depth, while vanilla, incense and myrrh give a resinous finish.

perfumes.name: Royal Princess Oud
perfumes.description: Rose and bergamot open bright, jasmine and vanilla fill the heart, and benzoin with sandalwood leave a sweet, resinous warmth.

perfumes.name: Spring Flower
perfumes.description: Bergamot, grapefruit and lemon begin fresh and zesty. Apricot, peach and jasmine add a fruity softness, and ambergris, cedarwood and musk keep it clean.

perfumes.name: Sublime Vanille
perfumes.description: Vanilla opens in a sweet, creamy way, and then tonka bean, lemon and bergamot lift it into sunlight. A gentle musk rounds off the end.

perfumes.name: Tabarome Millésime
perfumes.description: Ginger, pink pepper and grapefruit give a spiced citrus start. Tea, coffee, rum and blackcurrant fill the heart, and sandalwood and tobacco close it warm.

perfumes.name: Viking Cologne
perfumes.description: Lemon, pink pepper, bergamot and mandarin open lively. Lavender, geranium, nutmeg and sage add herbal spice, and sandalwood, patchouli, frankincense, cedarwood and vetiver give a woody base.

perfumes.name: Wind Flowers
perfumes.description: Peach and orange blossom open over a jasmine, tuberose and rose bouquet. Musk, praline, sandalwood and iris leave it creamy and powdery.

perfumes.name: Cool Water
perfumes.description: A cool rush of mint, lavender, rosemary and sea notes opens, with jasmine and geranium softening the heart. Sandalwood, musk and oakmoss give it a clean, mossy base.

perfumes.name: Addict Eau Fraîche
perfumes.description: Bright bergamot opens onto lily of the valley and freesia, then settles on soft musk. A clean, dewy floral that stays light and airy throughout.

perfumes.name: Dior Homme Parfum
perfumes.description: Iris sits at the centre, powdery and cool, wrapped in warm amber and patchouli with a dry vetiver edge. Earthy and softly smooth.

perfumes.name: Dior Homme Sport
perfumes.description: Bergamot brightness gives way to elemi and pink pepper, then settles into a dry, warm frankincense. A crisp, resinous scent with a spicy edge.

perfumes.name: Fahrenheit Parfum
perfumes.description: Mandarin brightens a smoky heart of leather and violet, all of it resting on sweet vanilla. Powdery and dark at the edges, with a quiet warmth underneath.

perfumes.name: Fahrenheit
perfumes.description: Lavender, mandarin and bergamot lift a floral heart of jasmine, honeysuckle and violet leaf, before leather, tonka bean and vetiver take over. Crisp, unusual and gradually warmer.

perfumes.name: Homme
perfumes.description: Earthy and woody from start to finish: cedarwood leads, patchouli adds a damp, dark depth, and vetiver dries everything down to a quiet root.

perfumes.name: Homme Cologne
perfumes.description: A cool splash of bergamot and grapefruit over clean musk. Light, crisp and simple, it reads like freshly laundered linen in morning sun.

perfumes.name: Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Jasmine sambac sits in a warm, creamy cloud of tonka bean and vanilla. Sweet, enveloping and slightly narcotic, it unfolds slowly on skin.

perfumes.name: J'adore Infinissime
perfumes.description: A radiant bouquet of rose, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang and tuberose, brightened by bergamot and blood orange and settling onto creamy sandalwood. Rounded and soft.

perfumes.name: Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming
perfumes.description: Red berries give a juicy first impression before peony and rose open up. A clean musk keeps the whole bouquet light and fresh.

perfumes.name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet
perfumes.description: Peony and rose gather in a fresh, airy bouquet, lifted by bergamot and finished with clean, soft musk. Gentle, springlike and uncomplicated.

perfumes.name: Miss Dior Parfum
perfumes.description: Mandarin opens a rounded jasmine heart, then amberwood brings a creamy, glowing warmth. Floral and citrusy at first, softer and deeper as it dries.

perfumes.name: Miss Dior Rose N'Roses
perfumes.description: Rose leads in a sparkling, dewy way, with mandarin adding a citrus lift and soft musk trailing behind. A light, fresh floral.

perfumes.name: Poison Girl
perfumes.description: Bitter orange gives a zesty edge to a bright rose, with tonka bean adding a sweet, soft warmth underneath. Playful and fresh.

perfumes.name: Pure Poison
perfumes.description: Bergamot flickers over orange blossom, resting on soft, creamy musk. A white floral that feels clean, luminous and quietly sweet.

perfumes.name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Spicy and herbal at the heart: Sichuan pepper, anise, nutmeg and lavender, under a bright bergamot lift. Ambroxan and vanilla bring a smooth, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Sauvage
perfumes.description: Sharp, bright bergamot and pepper give way to amberwood with a warm, mineral glow. Crisp, spicy and easy to wear.

perfumes.name: Sauvage Eau Forte
perfumes.description: Cold spices and lavender sit over a smooth musk. Herbal and fresh, with a chilly bite that gradually softens against the skin.

perfumes.name: Sauvage Extrait
perfumes.description: Lavender and bergamot lift the opening before oud, patchouli, vetiver and cedarwood take over. Earthy and resinous underneath, with a fresh, citrus-bright edge that never fully fades.

perfumes.name: Sauvage Parfum
perfumes.description: Mandarin gives a juicy, sunlit opening before sweet tonka bean and creamy sandalwood. Warm and rounded, with citrus keeping it fresh.

perfumes.name: Do Son
perfumes.description: Rose, iris and orange blossom open soft, tuberose and pink pepper fill the heart, and benzoin with musk leave it creamy and warm.

perfumes.name: Eau de Lierre
perfumes.description: Galbanum opens green and sharp, cyclamen adds a cool floral note, and rosewood gives a light, woody finish. Like ivy on a damp wall.

perfumes.name: Eau de Minthé
perfumes.description: Nutmeg and mint start cool and spiced, geranium and rose add a floral heart, and patchouli rounds it with earthy depth.

perfumes.name: Eau Rose
perfumes.description: Lychee and blackcurrant give a juicy lift to a rose and jasmine heart. Honey, musk and cedarwood leave a soft, slightly sweet finish.

perfumes.name: Ilio
perfumes.description: Bergamot, prickly pear and jasmine make a simple, airy line. The fruit stays cool and slightly green, and the jasmine arrives late and soft.

perfumes.name: L'Eau des Hesperides
perfumes.description: Bitter orange and lemon open sharp, mint adds a cooling, herbal lift, and immortelle leaves a dry, golden finish. Fresh and a little bitter.

perfumes.name: Lunamaris
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, incense and labdanum form a slow, resinous line. Spiced at the start, smoky in the middle, warm and balsamic at the close.

perfumes.name: Philosykos
perfumes.description: Fig runs through the whole scent: the leaf, the milky fruit and the woody branch, with coconut and green leaves adding sweetness. Cedarwood grounds it.

perfumes.name: Vetyverio
perfumes.description: A spiced floral heart of geranium, ylang-ylang, rose, nutmeg and clove, brightened by bergamot and mandarin. Vetiver, musk and cedarwood end dry and clean.

perfumes.name: Devotion Intense, .
perfumes.description: Hazelnut, orange blossom and vanilla, soft and sweet. The floral heart turns creamy and warm against a gourmand frame.

perfumes.name: Intenso
perfumes.description: Basil, lavender and sandalwood. Herbal and fresh at first, then a calm woody base that rounds everything out.

perfumes.name: Light Blue Summer Vibes
perfumes.description: Bergamot's bright zest meets juicy peach, held by a dry line of cedarwood. Light, citrusy and fruity, with a clean woody finish.

perfumes.name: Light Blue
perfumes.description: Apple and cedarwood open crisp, with bamboo, jasmine and rose in the heart. Amber and musk soften the finish, giving a breezy, green-floral scent with a lemony brightness.

perfumes.name: Pour Homme
perfumes.description: Neroli, bergamot and mandarin open into lavender, sage and pepper. Sandalwood, tobacco and tonka bean close it. Fresh and herbal, with a warm, spiced base.

perfumes.name: Q by Dolce&Gabbana
perfumes.description: Lemon and blood orange start sharp and juicy, with jasmine adding a floral touch. Cherry and heliotrope bring a powdery sweetness, settling on cedarwood and a clean bed of musk.

perfumes.name: The One for Men Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Basil, coriander and grapefruit open aromatic, then cardamom, ginger and orange blossom warm the heart. Cedarwood, tobacco and amber make the base smooth, dry and softly spicy.

perfumes.name: Green Wood
perfumes.description: Lemon, santolina and pepper open sharp and herbal, with cedarwood, vetiver and resins in the heart. Cypriol, ambroxan and musk add a smoky, earthy base with a resinous warmth.

perfumes.name: Original Wood
perfumes.description: Violet leaf, cardamom and an aquatic accord open cool and green, followed by fir balsam, vetiver and cedarwood. Patchouli, amber and musk give the base a soft, earthy depth.

perfumes.name: Desire Blue
perfumes.description: Lychee, mandarin and bergamot lift a watery, citrusy start with lotus. Rosewood and sea notes lead into tonka bean, amber and musk.

perfumes.name: Icon
perfumes.description: Bergamot, neroli and pepper with juniper and sage feel aromatic and sharp, resting on vetiver, leather, oud and a dry touch of iris.

perfumes.name: London
perfumes.description: Bergamot, apple and cardamom brighten geranium, jasmine and rose. Patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla give it a smooth, warm base.

perfumes.name: White Tea
perfumes.description: Rose, maté and tonka bean make a gentle, green-floral blend. Fresh and lightly sweet, it feels airy and softly rounded.

perfumes.name: Myth
perfumes.description: Bergamot, blackcurrant and ambrette lead to orchid, lotus and jasmine. The finish is clean and skin-like, with musk, patchouli and cedarwood.

perfumes.name: Beautiful
perfumes.description: A full bouquet of rose, lily, tuberose and marigold with mandarin, joined by orange blossom and jasmine, then grounded by sandalwood, vetiver and amber.

perfumes.name: Cinnabar
perfumes.description: Mandarin, orange blossom and jasmine open over lily and clove, giving the florals a spicy warmth. Patchouli, sandalwood and frankincense finish the creamy, resinous drydown.

perfumes.name: White Linen
perfumes.description: A powdery floral of rose, jasmine and lily of the valley, softened by iris and grounded in dry vetiver, oakmoss and amber.

perfumes.name: Youth Dew
perfumes.description: Rose, daffodil and lavender open into jasmine and warm spice. Oakmoss, vetiver and patchouli give it an earthy, herbal depth.

perfumes.name: Musk
perfumes.description: Clean, bright and woody: bergamot, grapefruit and verbena over white rose and cedar, with sandalwood, vanilla and a musk finish.

perfumes.name: Udaipur
perfumes.description: Floral and creamy: bergamot, pink pepper and magnolia over jasmine sambac, gardenia and lotus, ending on patchouli, cashmere wood and musk.

perfumes.name: Via Verri
perfumes.description: Peppery citrus meets flowers: bergamot, pepper and jasmine, then iris, rose and cardamom, resting on cypress, amber and musk.

perfumes.name: Blue Talisman Extrait
perfumes.description: Pear and bergamot brighten orange blossom and jasmine. Vanilla, sandalwood and musk with amberwood make a creamy, glowing base. Floral, warm and smooth.

perfumes.name: Demon Dancer
perfumes.description: Rhubarb, mint and blood orange give a tart, sparkling start. Orange blossom and blackcurrant follow, with Georgywood, musk and tonka bean for a woody, clean base.

perfumes.name: Fleur Narcotique Extrait
perfumes.description: Bergamot, lychee and osmanthus open juicy and bright, then peony, orange blossom, jasmine and freesia fill the heart. Sandalwood, oakmoss and musk give it a smooth, creamy finish.

perfumes.name: Speed Legends
perfumes.description: Bergamot, mandarin and pink pepper open sharp and sunny, with clary sage and blackcurrant in the heart. Tonka bean, vetiver and amberwood add a warm, dry base.

perfumes.name: London Spice
perfumes.description: Lemon, bergamot and mint open crisp, then lavender, jasmine and sea notes make a breezy heart. Patchouli, cedarwood, nutmeg and cardamom warm the base with a gentle spice.

perfumes.name: Lucius
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, mandarin and bergamot sparkle first, then cedarwood and orange blossom, drying into tonka bean, vetiver and amber.

perfumes.name: Oud Noir Intense Parfum
perfumes.description: Bergamot and cardamom open bright and spiced, with rose and jasmine in the heart. Sandalwood, saffron, patchouli, vanilla and amber make a rich, warm and slightly sweet base.

perfumes.name: Oud Orange Intense
perfumes.description: Coconut and sweet fruit open soft and creamy, then vanilla takes over the heart. Musk and oud close it, a warm, resinous scent with a smooth, sugary glow.

perfumes.name: Eau de Magnolia
perfumes.description: Bergamot lifts an earthy magnolia heart threaded with vetiver and patchouli. Cedarwood, oakmoss and amber give it a mossy, woody base.

perfumes.name: Music for a While
perfumes.description: A fruity, comforting blend: lemon, mandarin and bergamot with lavender, falling to patchouli and labdanum.

perfumes.name: Northern Love
perfumes.description: Speculoos, saffron, nutmeg and cinnamon open like warm baking spice. Vanilla and jasmine soften the heart, and sandalwood, balsam of Peru, patchouli, leather and styrax leave a smoky, sweet base.

perfumes.name: Promise
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, rosemary and apple open crisp. Rose and Turkish rose are spiced with clove, then patchouli, ambroxan, labdanum and cypriol add an earthy, resinous depth.

perfumes.name: Sale Gosse
perfumes.description: A radiant, citrus-led blend: neroli, bergamot and petitgrain over a floral heart of daffodil, rose and violet, resting on musk.

perfumes.name: The Moon
perfumes.description: Raspberry, lychee and saffron open fruity and golden. Frankincense and Turkish rose form the heart, and oud and leather give a dark, smooth base.

perfumes.name: Liquid Brun
perfumes.description: Cinnamon, cardamom and bergamot meet orange blossom, then deepen into vanilla and elemi. Praline, musk and guaiac wood leave a sweet, resinous warmth.

perfumes.name: Angel Dust
perfumes.description: Amber opens warm and glowing, pink pepper adds a bright spice, and wood fills the heart. Cashmere wood gives the base a soft, smooth, dry finish.

perfumes.name: Orange Crush
perfumes.description: Orange is juicy and bright, sitting over a clear heart of musk. Pepperwood and akigalawood add a dry, peppery warmth underneath, so the citrus fades into something clean and woody.

perfumes.name: Parfum 1
perfumes.description: Citrus, blackcurrant, mint and mandarin open fresh and green, followed by davana, frankincense, orange blossom and pink pepper. Patchouli, musk, sandalwood and cedarwood make a soft, woody base.

perfumes.name: Passionfroudh
perfumes.description: Ginger, marigold, tea and passion fruit open tangy and bright, with mango, pepper, rose and frankincense in the heart. Gurjum balsam, cypriol and oud give a deep, resinous base.

perfumes.name: Sugardaddy
perfumes.description: Mandarin, bergamot and blackcurrant open juicy, then nutmeg, clove, jasmine and ambergris add warm spice. Oakmoss, cashmere wood and patchouli make a dark, earthy finish.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Haze
perfumes.description: Mandarin, coconut, almond and hazelnut open sweet and nutty, then vanilla, tonka bean and jasmine make a creamy heart. Crème brûlée, amber and musk end it soft and sugared.

perfumes.name: Bianco Latte
perfumes.description: Caramel and honey give a milky sweetness, with coumarin adding a warm hay-like softness. Vanilla and musk close it clean and gentle, like warm milk with a spoonful of sugar.

perfumes.name: Ange ou Démon
perfumes.description: Mandarin, thyme and saffron open bright and herbal, lily forms a fresh floral heart, and oakwood leaves a dry, woody close.

perfumes.name: Gentleman Eau de Toilette
perfumes.description: Pear and violet leaf open green and fruity, iris and lavender form a powdery, herbal heart, and leather and patchouli close dry and earthy.

perfumes.name: Gentleman Society
perfumes.description: Sage and cardamom open herbal and spiced, daffodil and vetiver form a floral, earthy heart, and cedarwood, sandalwood and vanilla close warm and woody.

perfumes.name: Irresistible Givenchy
perfumes.description: A soft pear and ambrette start moves into rose and iris, powdery and fruity, set on clean cedarwood and white woods.

perfumes.name: Irresistible
perfumes.description: Pear and ambrette brighten the start, rose and iris form a powdery floral centre, and cedarwood with white woods holds it all together.

perfumes.name: You Doux
perfumes.description: Violet and a hush of powder sit above palo santo, frankincense and myrrh, resting on soft ambrette and ambroxan.

perfumes.name: Bloom Intense
perfumes.description: Pear and ginger lead into a creamy bouquet of jasmine and orange blossom, then drift down to earthy patchouli and a soft coconut warmth.

perfumes.name: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense
perfumes.description: Mandarin opens bright, gardenia forms a creamy floral heart, and sandalwood leaves a smooth, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Flora Gorgeous Jasmine
perfumes.description: Mandarin, bergamot and pepper open bright, jasmine, magnolia, jasmine sambac and rose make a creamy floral heart, and sandalwood, benzoin and patchouli close warm.

perfumes.name: Gucci Bloom Acqua di Fiori
perfumes.description: Galbanum and blackcurrant add a green, fruity sparkle to creamy tuberose, jasmine and honeysuckle. Musk and sandalwood keep it soft.

perfumes.name: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia
perfumes.description: Magnolia, jasmine sambac and lily of the valley bloom over blackberry and coconut. Musk and white woods keep the creamy floral clean and smooth.

perfumes.name: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid
perfumes.description: Vanilla runs from start to finish, softened by a salty hint of sea notes. Sweet and warm, with a fresh, airy edge.

perfumes.name: Gucci Guilty Absolute
perfumes.description: Leather, cypress and patchouli sit over vetiver and dry woods. Earthy and green, with a smoky depth that feels dark and textured.

perfumes.name: Gucci Intense Oud
perfumes.description: Pepper and frankincense open onto amberwood, sandalwood and cedarwood. Leather, patchouli and oud sit at the base, giving a resinous, warm and woody depth.

perfumes.name: Gucci Oud
perfumes.description: Pear, raspberry and saffron brighten a heart of rose and orange blossom. Oud and patchouli ground it, making a fruity floral with an earthy, spiced core.

perfumes.name: Gucci Pour Homme
perfumes.description: Bergamot, cypress and violet open green and bright, jasmine and tobacco form a smoky heart, and frankincense, amber, patchouli, leather and elemi close resinous and warm.

perfumes.name: Guilty Elixir de Parfum Pour Femme
perfumes.description: Bergamot and violet brighten the start before wisteria, rose and osmanthus open into a petal heart, settling onto vanilla, tonka bean and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Guilty Intense pour Homme
perfumes.description: Salt opens with a mineral edge, lavender forms an herbal heart, and palo santo leaves a soft, woody close.

perfumes.name: Angélique Noire
perfumes.description: Angelica carries a green, peppery bite through jasmine sambac and caraway, then returns in the base alongside vanilla and cedarwood. Spicy, earthy and softly floral.

perfumes.name: Aqua Allegoria Bergamote Calabria
perfumes.description: Crisp and bright with bergamot, pink pepper and green leaves. Cardamom and ginger warm the heart, and musk with vanilla gently round off the end.

perfumes.name: Aqua Allegoria Florabloom
perfumes.description: Bergamot, lime and mango sparkle over tuberose, rose, iris and violet. Musk, sandalwood and coconut leave a soft, powdery, slightly tropical trail.

perfumes.name: Aqua Allegoria Forte Mandarine Basilic
perfumes.description: Mandarin and basil open crisp and herbal, with a touch of blackcurrant. Rose, vanilla and orange blossom fill the heart before cedarwood, sandalwood and musk finish it.

perfumes.name: Aqua Allegoria Forte Nerolia Vetiver
perfumes.description: Green and juicy at first: bergamot, petitgrain and fig. Neroli and rose flower in the heart, and vetiver, cedarwood and tonka bean ground the dry-down.

perfumes.name: Aqua Allegoria Nerolia Vetiver
perfumes.description: Basil, bergamot and lemon open sharp and green. Fig, orange blossom and rose soften the heart, and neroli, vetiver and musk leave a clean, airy trail.

perfumes.name: Aqua Allegoria Pera Granita
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, lemon and bergamot start icy and bright. Pear, osmanthus and orange blossom follow, with oakmoss, musk and cedarwood adding a soft, mossy depth.

perfumes.name: Cruel Gardénia
perfumes.description: Rose, peach and neroli give a soft, fruity start before gardenia and ylang-ylang bloom. Musk, tonka bean, vanilla and sandalwood finish creamy and sweet.

perfumes.name: Cuir Béluga
perfumes.description: Aldehydes and mandarin open airy and powdery. Patchouli and immortelle give an earthy heart, and vanilla, amber, heliotrope and suede end soft and velvety.

perfumes.name: Mon Guerlain Intense
perfumes.description: Sunny bergamot, mandarin and lavender open fresh. Jasmine sambac and vanilla build a sweet heart, over musk, patchouli and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Néroli Outrenoir
perfumes.description: Crisp petitgrain and bergamot lead into orange blossom and neroli, with a thread of smoked tea. Amber, oakmoss and myrrh darken the end.

perfumes.name: Samsara
perfumes.description: Honeysuckle opens softly into jasmine and ylang-ylang, before sandalwood, iris, tonka bean and vanilla settle in. Creamy, warm and floral.

perfumes.name: Santal Royal
perfumes.description: Neroli and jasmine open over peach, rose and a thread of cinnamon. Sandalwood, leather, amber, oud and musk close it out, floral first and then slowly warm.

perfumes.name: Spiritueuse Double Vanille
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, bergamot and frankincense open lightly spiced. Rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang bloom in the heart, then vanilla, benzoin, rum and cedarwood warm the base.

perfumes.name: Bella Vita
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant, cherry and lemon give a juicy lift to jasmine, tuberose and vanilla. Musk, praline, tonka bean and amberwood close the scent.

perfumes.name: Seductive
perfumes.description: Bergamot, blackcurrant and pear open fruity, followed by jasmine, orange blossom and a powdery iris. Frankincense and vanilla warm the base.

perfumes.name: Seductive Homme,
perfumes.description: Mandarin, cardamom and pink pepper lead into violet and vetiver, with a powdery, earthy softness. Amber, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm, woody base.

perfumes.name: 24, Faubourg
perfumes.description: Orange, peach and hyacinth glow over iris, gardenia and orange blossom. Vanilla, amber and sandalwood make the dry-down creamy, powdery and gently warm.

perfumes.name: Calèche
perfumes.description: Aldehydes, bergamot and neroli open sparkling, iris, rose and jasmine form a powdery, classic floral heart, and sandalwood, amber and oakmoss end soft and mossy.

perfumes.name: Jour d'Hermès
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, lemon and sea notes open crisp, with gardenia and green leaves in the heart. Musk and woody notes leave it airy and light.

perfumes.name: Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, bergamot and orange open zesty. Pepper, geranium and patchouli add a peppery heart, and vetiver, cedarwood and benzoin leave an earthy, dry base.

perfumes.name: Festival Nite
perfumes.description: Coconut, freesia and mandarin start light and creamy. Apple blossom and orchid lead to a soft, sweet base of vanilla, marshmallow and amber.

perfumes.name: BOSS Bottled Beyond
perfumes.description: Ginger opens with a hot, zesty bite, followed by a smoky leather heart. Woody notes in the base keep it dry and dark, giving the spice a rugged, smoulderingly warm edge.

perfumes.name: Boss Bottled Parfum
perfumes.description: Mandarin and incense open into iris and fig. Cedarwood and leather support them. A fruity, powdery scent with a dry, woody and smoky backdrop.

perfumes.name: Boss Bottled Triumph Elixir
perfumes.description: Violet leaf brings a green, slightly watery start, and vetiver gives the heart a dry, earthy backbone. Patchouli deepens the base, so the scent feels cool and grounded.

perfumes.name: BOSS In Motion
perfumes.description: Basil, bergamot and violet leaf start fresh, while cardamom, nutmeg, cinnamon and pink pepper make the middle spicy. Musk, sandalwood and vetiver close it woody.

perfumes.name: The Scent for Her
perfumes.description: Juicy peach opens soft and sweet, with osmanthus adding a delicate, apricot-like floral heart. Musk keeps the finish clean and close to the skin.

perfumes.name: Oud for Greatness Neo
perfumes.description: Oud meets a cool burst of bergamot, lavender and fir balsam. Green, herbal and fresh, it replaces the usual heaviness with a clear, resinous brightness.

perfumes.name: Sugar Blast
perfumes.description: Lavender and coconut open soft, then vanilla, praline and rum build a sweet, boozy core. Cashmeran and ambroxan leave a smooth, woody base.

perfumes.name: Wild Rush
perfumes.description: Warm vanilla and caramel are brightened by bergamot and lavender. Red berries add a juicy edge, and sandalwood and patchouli give it a quiet depth.

perfumes.name: L'Eau d'Issey
perfumes.description: Rose and lotus lead into a cloud of white flowers. Wood and sandalwood add a creamy, calm finish. Watery, floral and understated.

perfumes.name: Classic
perfumes.description: A brisk mix of orange, juniper, lavender and basil, softened by ginger, orange blossom and lotus. Sandalwood and musk leave a clean, herbal finish.

perfumes.name: Classic Black
perfumes.description: Orange, mandarin and apple give a crisp citrus-fruit start. Tea, nutmeg and cardamom add dry spice before cedarwood, musk and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Classique
perfumes.description: Ginger sparks at the top, orange blossom makes a powdery floral heart, and amber leaves a warm, sweet finish. Soft, classic and spiced.

perfumes.name: Fleur du Male
perfumes.description: Petitgrain opens green and fresh, fern and orange blossom form a clean floral heart, and coumarin leaves a soft, hay-like sweetness.

perfumes.name: La Belle Paradise Garden
perfumes.description: Water lily, iris and vanilla move from watery to powdery to sweet. A soft floral that ends warm and lightly gourmand.

perfumes.name: La Favorite
perfumes.description: Queen of the night flower opens a resinous heart of benzoin, settling onto tonka bean. Warm, sweet and softly floral, it reads like blossom melted into amber.

perfumes.name: Le Beau Narcisse
perfumes.description: Bergamot brightens a clean veil of musk, and tonka bean rounds the finish into something soft and sweet. Skin-close and quietly sunlit.

perfumes.name: Le Beau Paradise Garden
perfumes.description: Coconut and fig give this a milky, fruity start, then sandalwood slowly lifts it into warm, sweet woods. Easy, creamy and lightly tropical.

perfumes.name: Le Beau
perfumes.description: Sweet and warm, with bergamot adding a cool flash up front. Coconut turns the middle creamy, and tonka bean leaves a soft, rounded base.

perfumes.name: Le Male Elixir Absolu
perfumes.description: Plum and lavender meet in an herbal, fruity opening that feels fresh before tonka bean sweetens everything. The mood is bright, green and a touch gourmand.

perfumes.name: Le Male
perfumes.description: Mint and lavender give a cool, herbal start, which melts into a warm vanilla base. Fresh at first, then sweet and cosy.

perfumes.name: Scandal Absolu
perfumes.description: Fig, sandalwood and tuberose pull fruit, woods and cream into one rounded line. The feel is floral and woody, smooth rather than sharp.

perfumes.name: Scandal Le Parfum
perfumes.description: Jasmine over caramel and a pinch of salt makes a sweet, salty contrast that settles into warm vanilla. Floral on top, gourmand underneath.

perfumes.name: Scandal pour Homme Intense
perfumes.description: Clary sage and vetiver keep it earthy and herbal, with a smoky streak of leather underneath. Fresh at the edges, dry and grounded at the centre.

perfumes.name: Scandal pour Homme le Parfum
perfumes.description: Geranium opens green and floral before tonka bean and sandalwood take over. A sweet, woody, warm drydown with a gentle petal edge.

perfumes.name: Blossom
perfumes.description: Citrus, red berries and raspberry give a juicy start, with sweet pea and rose forming a soft floral heart. Sandalwood and musk keep the finish gentle and clean.

perfumes.name: Fever
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, lychee and plum open juicy, then heliotrope, vanilla and jasmine turn soft and sweet. Tonka bean, sandalwood and benzoin add warmth.

perfumes.name: I Want Choo Forever
perfumes.description: Strawberry, pink pepper and rose open playfully, with cherry, almond and jasmine sambac at the heart. Oakmoss, vanilla and tonka bean give a sweet, warm landing.

perfumes.name: Illicit
perfumes.description: Ginger and orange open with a warm, zesty snap, then rose and jasmine bloom in the heart. Honey, amber and sandalwood make the base golden, rich and smooth.

perfumes.name: Jimmy Choo Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Green leaves, pear and mandarin open crisp and fresh, with orchid in the heart. Patchouli and toffee give the base a sweet, earthy depth that softens the brightness.

perfumes.name: Jimmy Choo Man
perfumes.description: Lavender, melon and mandarin open fresh and a little fruity, followed by pink pepper, geranium and pineapple. Patchouli, suede and amberwood close it warm, dry and softly spiced.

perfumes.name: Jimmy Choo Man Blue
perfumes.description: Clary sage, pepper and bergamot open aromatic, with leather, cypress and ambergris in a smoky heart. Sandalwood, vanilla and vetiver make a warm, smooth base beneath the green freshness.

perfumes.name: Man Ice
perfumes.description: Mandarin, bergamot and lemon start icy and bright. Vetiver, patchouli, cedarwood and apple form an earthy heart, ending in musk, oakmoss and ambroxan.

perfumes.name: Scarlet Poppy Intense
perfumes.description: Built around poppy, iris and tonka bean, it reads powdery, floral and sweet, with a warm, rounded finish.

perfumes.name: Sea Salt & Bergamot
perfumes.description: Bergamot opens sharp, sea notes bring a salty, mineral freshness, and driftwood adds a dry, sun-bleached warmth. Clean and breezy.

perfumes.name: Tangerine Honey
perfumes.description: Mandarin and honey form a bright, sweet duo, with a thread of tobacco adding a faint smoky depth. Sunny and golden.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Scotch
perfumes.description: Whisky and vanilla meet amber in a smooth, sweet blend. Warm and slightly boozy, with a soft, golden glow.

perfumes.name: Joop Homme
perfumes.description: Cardamom opens with a dry spice, then hazelnut and vanilla turn it gourmand. Tonka bean keeps the base sweet and warm.

perfumes.name: Viva La Juicy
perfumes.description: Mandarin and red berries lead to gardenia, honeysuckle and jasmine. Caramel, amber and vanilla over sandalwood and praline make the finish sweet and creamy.

perfumes.name: Viva La Juicy Gold Couture
perfumes.description: Wild berries and lily of the valley open beside gardenia, then vanilla and honeysuckle appear. Caramel, praline and sandalwood close it softly.

perfumes.name: Anyway
perfumes.description: Lime flickers over jasmine, then ambroxan and hedione take over. A bright, airy floral with a creamy, glowing amber trail.

perfumes.name: Banana Rush
perfumes.description: Banana and maple bring a playful sweetness, joined by coconut and frangipani. Vanilla and sandalwood smooth the end. A tropical, dessert-like scent.

perfumes.name: Gentlewoman
perfumes.description: Bergamot and neroli give a bright, citrus-floral lift. Almond adds a sweet, creamy touch, and musk keeps the finish soft and close.

perfumes.name: Juliette
perfumes.description: Cherry and pink pepper open sweet and lively, with cashmeran and jasmine making a soft, warm heart. Ambroxan and tonka bean smooth the finish into a creamy, woody glow.

perfumes.name: Lili Fantasy
perfumes.description: Bubble gum gives a playful, sugary opening to jasmine and tuberose. Amber and ambroxan keep the floral creamy and warm.

perfumes.name: Lust For Sun
perfumes.description: Bergamot, coconut and freesia open lightly, then gardenia, monoi and ylang-ylang turn creamy and sunlit. Musk and vanilla linger, sweet and warm.

perfumes.name: Miami Shake
perfumes.description: Strawberry, chantilly cream and ice cream make a sweet, milkshake-like heart with orange blossom. Vanilla and musk keep it soft, warm and fruity.

perfumes.name: Mmmm...
perfumes.description: Neroli and orange blossom give a creamy, softly sweet white floral that stays gentle. Patchouli grounds the base with a faint earthiness, adding depth to the soft petals.

perfumes.name: Musc Invisible
perfumes.description: Close to skin: jasmine, fresh cotton and musk, clean and creamy. It reads as a soft, quiet floral rather than a scent you notice at once.

perfumes.name: Ode to Dullness
perfumes.description: Anise and freesia open quietly, leading to cashmere wood and sandalwood. Musk and tonka bean finish it soft. A warm, woody scent with a hint of spice.

perfumes.name: Powder Love
perfumes.description: Marshmallow and cotton candy open a soft, sugary haze that settles into almond and orange blossom, then dries down to tonka bean, ambroxan and musk.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Vibes
perfumes.description: A pinch of salt opens, then vanilla fills the heart, smooth and a little sweet. Musk keeps it close and clean, so the warmth feels comforting rather than heavy.

perfumes.name: Almaz
perfumes.description: Bergamot and blackcurrant open bright, followed by raspberry, rose, iris and heliotrope in a powdery, fruity heart. Musk, vanilla, amber and brown sugar leave a sweet, soft finish.

perfumes.name: Dahab
perfumes.description: Apple and bergamot open crisp, with passion fruit, coriander and cedarwood in a spiced, fruity heart. Patchouli, musk and amber make the base warm, earthy and soft.

perfumes.name: Faris
perfumes.description: Apple, orange, lavender, bergamot and lemon open fresh, with rose, jasmine, coriander, nutmeg and clove adding spice to the heart. Amber, sandalwood, tonka bean and vetiver settle warmly.

perfumes.name: Lamar
perfumes.description: Pineapple, red berries and apple open juicy, with cardamom and coriander adding a spiced lift. Rose, magnolia and jasmine sambac fill the heart, while ambroxan, oakmoss and toffee close it.

perfumes.name: Eden Juicy Apple
perfumes.description: Crisp apple, grapefruit and lychee give way to jasmine and rose with a berry sweetness, settling into soft vanilla, amber and musk. Juicy, floral and gently warm.

perfumes.name: Elixir 11
perfumes.description: Apple and rose spark the top, and jasmine sambac deepens a floral heart. Patchouli, vanilla and amber give the base a warm, sweet glow.

perfumes.name: Oudgasm Rose Oud
perfumes.description: Pear, lemon and geranium open bright, then rose and peony form a soft floral centre. Vanilla, cashmere wood and oud carry a sweet, quiet depth.

perfumes.name: Oudgasm Vanilla Oud
perfumes.description: Praline and saffron lend pear a sweet, spiced richness, with rose at the centre. Oud, vanilla, musk and oakmoss make a warm, woody base.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Royale Sugared Patchouli
perfumes.description: Rum gives the opening a boozy edge over vanilla and jasmine. Tonka bean softens the heart, while brown sugar, patchouli and amber keep the base warm and earthy.

perfumes.name: Flower by Kenzo
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant and pink pepper add a little sparkle before rose and violet take over in a powdery heart. Musk and vanilla keep the finish soft and warm.

perfumes.name: Kenzo Homme Intense
perfumes.description: Sea notes and pink pepper start salty and spiced. Fig and vetiver add an earthy middle, and sandalwood and akigalawood finish it woody.

perfumes.name: Icon
perfumes.description: Bergamot opens briefly before incense, lavender and labdanum take the heart. Amber, suede and sandalwood leave a resinous, herbal warmth.

perfumes.name: Angels Share Paradis
perfumes.description: Raspberry gives a bright, juicy edge to warm cognac, while oakmoss lends an earthy, woody depth. Sweet, boozy and slightly mossy.

perfumes.name: Dark Lord
perfumes.description: Pepper opens with a dry spice, jasmine blooms creamily in the heart, and vetiver grounds everything in earth. Dark, floral and calm.

perfumes.name: Fievre Verte
perfumes.description: Absinthe and violet leaf give a green, herbal chill, with patchouli adding earthy depth. Cool, sharp and quietly bitter.

perfumes.name: Musk Oud
perfumes.description: Rum opens warm and sweet, geranium and davana bring a green floral note, and oud, patchouli and musk make a dark, earthy base.

perfumes.name: Straight to Heaven
perfumes.description: Patchouli, nutmeg and cedarwood: earthy, dry and warmly spiced. A woody scent that stays smooth and quiet.

perfumes.name: Voulez Vous Coucher Avec Moi
perfumes.description: Tuberose leads into ylang-ylang and gardenia, a creamy, heady white floral. Sandalwood and vanilla soften the base into something sweet and smooth.

perfumes.name: L.12.12 Blanc
perfumes.description: Grapefruit and cardamom give a crisp, spicy-bright opening, followed by creamy tuberose and ylang-ylang. Vetiver and suede close it dry, a white floral with an unexpected cool edge.

perfumes.name: Lacoste Essential
perfumes.description: Bergamot, mandarin and blackcurrant leaf open crisp, with pepper and rose in the heart. Patchouli and sandalwood leave a clean, lightly spicy woody finish.

perfumes.name: Lacoste Pour Femme
perfumes.description: Freesia and pepper introduce a powdery floral heart of jasmine and heliotrope, finishing in dry cedarwood and soft suede.

perfumes.name: Pour Homme Lion
perfumes.description: Rosemary, grapefruit, bergamot and lavender open fresh and aromatic, followed by jasmine, iris and cedarwood. Amber, oakmoss, patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla make a warm, mossy base.

perfumes.name: Hypnôse
perfumes.description: Passion flower gives a lightly floral start before a warm vanilla heart and an earthy base of vetiver.

perfumes.name: Idole Nectar
perfumes.description: Rose, popcorn and vanilla: a sweet, warm and slightly playful blend. Soft florals meet a toasty gourmand base.

perfumes.name: La vie est belle Iris Absolu
perfumes.description: Fig and blackcurrant open fruity, jasmine blooms in the heart, and patchouli with iris leaves a powdery, earthy base.

perfumes.name: La vie est belle L'Éclat
perfumes.description: Bergamot, mandarin and freesia open bright. Orange blossom, iris and jasmine sambac form a creamy, powdery heart, and sandalwood, vanilla and patchouli close it softly.

perfumes.name: La Vie Est Belle
perfumes.description: Pear and blackcurrant lead into iris, orange blossom and jasmine sambac, ending in a sweet blend of praline, vanilla and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Trésor
perfumes.description: Apricot blossom and rose open soft, lilac, iris and peach make a powdery, fruity heart, and amber, sandalwood, musk and vanilla leave a warm, creamy finish.

perfumes.name: Angham
perfumes.description: Ginger and pink pepper add a spark to mandarin, and praline with chocolate makes the heart sweet and rich. Vanilla, amber and musk are soft and warm.

perfumes.name: Asad Elixir
