perfumes.description: Saffron and pink pepper open spiced, with tobacco and vanilla in the heart. Frankincense, patchouli and amber make a deep, warm base.

perfumes.name: Atlas Canyon
perfumes.description: Bergamot, ginger and lemon open cleanly, then lily of the valley and sea notes keep the centre airy. Ambroxan, oakmoss and musk add a mineral finish.

perfumes.name: Atlas Glacial Valley
perfumes.description: Fig, pineapple and mint start green and juicy, with salt and jasmine in the heart. Oakmoss, vanilla and musk give the base an earthy, soft close.

perfumes.name: Dynasty
perfumes.description: Raspberry sits beside bergamot and ginger, with clary sage and nutmeg adding a herbal spice. Tea and suede soften the heart, and cedarwood and amberwood dry it out.

perfumes.name: Hayaati
perfumes.description: Nutmeg, ginger and pink pepper give a spiced opening, then incense and labdanum build a resinous centre. Cedarwood, amber and musk finish warm and dry.

perfumes.name: His Confession
perfumes.description: Cinnamon, lavender and mandarin open aromatic, then cypress and iris cool the heart. Vanilla, tonka bean and incense settle into a warm, woody drydown.

perfumes.name: Oud Mood Elixir
perfumes.description: Saffron, nutmeg and cinnamon give a spiced start, and oud with suede and sandalwood carries it into smoke. Amber and vanilla keep it warm.

perfumes.name: Qaed Al Fursan
perfumes.description: Pineapple and saffron start bright with a fruity edge, and fir balsam gives the heart a green, resinous lift. Amber, cedarwood and oud close warm.

perfumes.name: Yara Tous
perfumes.description: Mango, coconut and passion fruit give a lush, creamy start. Jasmine, heliotrope and orange blossom bloom in the heart, and vanilla, musk and cashmeran keep it soft.

perfumes.name: Rose 31
perfumes.description: Rose and cumin start spicy, then rose deepens alongside vetiver and cedarwood. Musk, guaiac wood, frankincense, labdanum and oud give a smoky, resinous base.

perfumes.name: Thé Matcha 26
perfumes.description: Fig, bergamot and bitter orange give a green, juicy start with tea at its core. Sesame, cedarwood and vetiver add a toasted, woody calm.

perfumes.name: Cuir Infrarouge
perfumes.description: Bergamot, cinnamon and raspberry spark the opening, followed by cedarwood, iris and osmanthus. Leather, oud, patchouli and vanilla make a deep, powdery and slightly sweet base.

perfumes.name: Musc Nurasana
perfumes.description: Bergamot opens clean, while frankincense and rose share a resinous, floral heart. Musk carries it through to the end, soft and close to the skin.

perfumes.name: Autumn Vibes
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, cardamom and coriander give a crisp spiced start, then nutmeg and maple add a sweet, earthy turn. Cedarwood and oakmoss ground it.

perfumes.name: Beach Walk
perfumes.description: Bergamot and lemon open sunny, with ylang-ylang and coconut giving a warm floral heart. A base of musk, cedarwood and benzoin keeps it soft and skin-like.

perfumes.name: By the Fireplace
perfumes.description: Clove and pink pepper crackle like embers, with chestnut and guaiac wood adding a smoky sweetness. Vanilla and cashmeran leave a soft, woody glow.

perfumes.name: Coffee Break
perfumes.description: Coffee and milk sit in the heart alongside lavender and tonka bean, giving a creamy, slightly herbal sweetness. Vanilla, cedarwood and vetiver close it warmly.

perfumes.name: Jazz Club
perfumes.description: Neroli and pink pepper open lightly, then rum and sage bring a smooth, herbal warmth. Tobacco and vanilla finish sweet and low-lit.

perfumes.name: Replica Jazz Club
perfumes.description: Lemon and neroli keep the opening fresh, with clary sage and rum giving the heart a herbal, boozy turn. Tobacco, styrax and vanilla leave a sweet, warm trail.

perfumes.name: Sailing Day
perfumes.description: Aldehydes and juniper give a crisp, airy start with an aquatic feel. Iris adds powder, coriander a faint spice, and ambergris a clean, warm finish.

perfumes.name: When the Rain Stops
perfumes.description: Rain on green leaves: a vegetal accord and bergamot, then rose and jasmine over an aquatic note. Pine needle, patchouli and oakmoss turn earthy.

perfumes.name: Icarus 347
perfumes.description: Melon and apple open juicy and green, with raspberry and patchouli giving the heart a sweet, earthy twist. Tonka bean, oakmoss and ambroxan make a soft, mossy base.

perfumes.name: Amore Caffè
perfumes.description: Coffee and amaretto lead into a dessert-like heart of ice cream and speculoos, resting on vanilla, brown sugar and ambergris. Sweet, warm and amber-toned.

perfumes.name: Aoud Lemon Mint
perfumes.description: Mandarin and lemon sit beside almond and coriander at the top, with oud, patchouli and jasmine in the heart. Vetiver, leather and vanilla add earthy depth.

perfumes.name: Cosmic Pepper
perfumes.description: Pink pepper and pepper crackle over lemon and mandarin, then oud and rose warm the centre. Labdanum, amber and tonka bean give it a resinous, spiced finish.

perfumes.name: Feminity
perfumes.description: Mandarin and pink pepper start brisk, with coffee and leather adding a dark edge. Violet and jasmine soften the heart, and vanilla, toffee and sandalwood finish sweet.

perfumes.name: Intense Cedrat Boise
perfumes.description: Citrus and spice open over blackcurrant, then leather, oud and sandalwood build a woody, earthy heart. Vanilla and ambergris keep the base warm.

perfumes.name: Roses Vanille
perfumes.description: Lemon brightens the opening, then rose and Turkish delight make a sweet, floral heart. Cedarwood, vanilla and musk keep the base soft and warm.

perfumes.name: Ganymede
perfumes.description: Mandarin lightens a smoky centre of osmanthus and leather. Akigalawood and immortelle give the base a dry, resinous edge.

perfumes.name: Tilia
perfumes.description: Linden blossom, jasmine sambac and broom open soft and floral, then heliotrope, orange blossom and vetiver add a green, powdery heart. Ambrofix and Georgywood leave a smooth, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Bang
perfumes.description: Pepper and pink pepper crackle above woody notes. The base turns earthy and resinous, with benzoin, patchouli, vetiver and lichen.

perfumes.name: Daisy
perfumes.description: Wild berries add a tart, juicy start before violet and jasmine form a soft, powdery floral heart. Sandalwood warms the base, making a light, sweet and woody scent.

perfumes.name: Perfect Intense
perfumes.description: Daffodil and jasmine open green and floral, then almond turns the heart creamy and sweet. Sandalwood gives the base a smooth, warm, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Radical Rose
perfumes.description: Saffron opens with a warm, dry spice that frames a deep heart of rose. Patchouli adds an earthy, dark base, making a rose that feels dry and unsweetened.

perfumes.name: Cappadocia
perfumes.description: Saffron opens with a bright, golden spice, and sandalwood gives the heart a smooth, creamy warmth. Myrrh closes it in resinous depth, a warm woody scent that stays calm and dry.

perfumes.name: Darling Point
perfumes.description: Cinnamon, pear and apple open spiced and juicy, then jasmine, orange blossom, saffron and rose bloom together. Cashmere wood, oakmoss and praline settle into a sweet, soft and slightly mossy base.

perfumes.name: French Leather
perfumes.description: Juniper, lime and bergamot open sharp and green, with rose, clary sage and hay in a dry, herbal heart. Cedarwood and suede give it a soft, dry, suede-like finish.

perfumes.name: Italian Leather
perfumes.description: Tomato leaf lends a green, juicy bite, with vanilla softening the heart. Leather lies underneath, smoky and warm, so the green start slowly deepens into something smooth.

perfumes.name: Winter Palace
perfumes.description: Bergamot is bright and clean, tea adds a calm, green, slightly tannic heart, and amberwood warms the base. A quiet, fresh scent that fades into a gentle golden glow.

perfumes.name: Select
perfumes.description: Bergamot and blackcurrant meet a cool heart of mint and apple, drying into ambroxan, musk and a trace of patchouli.

perfumes.name: Select Night
perfumes.description: Lavender, cardamom and bergamot start fresh and aromatic. Orange blossom and cedarwood follow, ending in vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli.

perfumes.name: Fleur de Lait
perfumes.description: Mango opens ripe and juicy, osmanthus gives the heart a delicate, apricot-like bloom, and coconut closes it soft and creamy. Sweet and gentle, with a tropical warmth.

perfumes.name: Amber Musk :
perfumes.description: Amber, musk and cedarwood in a plain, close arrangement. Ambergris adds a salty softness, so the whole thing reads warm, woody and quietly skin-like.

perfumes.name: Be My Plum :
perfumes.description: Plum and oud open with a pink pepper edge, then tuberose, tiaré and ylang-ylang bloom creamy and fruity. Coconut, vanilla and musk keep it soft.

perfumes.name: Crazy In Love :
perfumes.description: Saffron and cardamom light the opening, with rose and violet in the heart. Sandalwood, amber, vanilla and brown sugar leave a warm, sweet, floral base.

perfumes.name: Dallachaï :
perfumes.description: Cardamom, clove and saffron meet passion fruit for a spiced, juicy start. Coffee and milk create a creamy heart, and amber and musk settle softly.

perfumes.name: Herbal Aquatica :
perfumes.description: Bergamot, sage and mint open fresh, and tea with papyrus keeps the heart airy. Caramel, amber, sandalwood and vanilla give it a sweet, woody ending.

perfumes.name: INTENSE Roses Musk :
perfumes.description: Rose is the centre, brightened by lemon and held by amber and musk. A soft, citrus-touched floral that dries down warm.

perfumes.name: Intense Starry Nights :
perfumes.description: Bergamot and lemon open crisp, then rose, jasmine and patchouli bring an earthy floral heart. Amber, vanilla and musk leave a warm, clean finish.

perfumes.name: Ristretto Intense Café :
perfumes.description: Coffee and rose share the top and heart, so the two blend into one roasted floral idea. Vanilla, toffee, musk and amber add a sweet, warm base.

perfumes.name: Soleil de Capri :
perfumes.description: Lemon, lime, apple and pear make a bright, juicy start. Jasmine, violet and peach turn powdery in the heart, and amber, cedarwood and musk soften the finish.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Extasy :
perfumes.description: Peach and apricot glow over bergamot, then lavender, jasmine and ylang-ylang make a creamy floral heart. Vanilla, benzoin and sandalwood wrap it warmly.

perfumes.name: Vanille Absolu :
perfumes.description: Plum and cherry give a ripe, dark-fruit start, and vanilla with caramel makes the heart sweet and warm. A base of musk keeps it smooth and close.

perfumes.name: Wood and Spices
perfumes.description: Bergamot and mandarin brighten a spiced opening of pepper, then orange blossom and sage lead into tobacco, vanilla and teak wood. Warm, citrusy, dry.

perfumes.name: Explorer Infinite
perfumes.description: Lemon opens sharp and bright over a heart of earthy patchouli. Musk smooths the base, giving a fresh yet grounded scent that moves from zest to soil.

perfumes.name: Individuel
perfumes.description: Pineapple, bergamot and juniper open bright, then lavender, mint and rosemary add an herbal freshness. Violet and orange blossom lead to a warm base of amber, sandalwood and tonka bean.

perfumes.name: Legend Blue
perfumes.description: Cool mint opens fresh and green over a heart of cedarwood. Ambroxan gives the base a smooth, clean amber glow, so the scent feels airy, woody and bright.

perfumes.name: Legend Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Bergamot and violet open lightly, with jasmine and geranium forming a soft floral heart. Oakmoss and wood close it, adding a powdery, slightly mossy dryness.

perfumes.name: Legend Red
perfumes.description: Blood orange opens with a sweet-sharp zest, and sage lends an herbal, aromatic heart. Mahogany in the base adds a smooth, dry wood, keeping the citrus fresh but grounded.

perfumes.name: Alien Extraintense
perfumes.description: Jasmine and tuberose form a creamy, heady heart, while cashmeran and vanilla add a soft, woody sweetness. Dense, floral and enveloping.

perfumes.name: Alien Goddess
perfumes.description: Coconut and bergamot open bright and creamy, jasmine blooms in the heart, and benzoin and vanilla leave a sweet, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Angel Fantasm
perfumes.description: Pineapple opens juicy and sweet, tiare adds a creamy tropical floral heart, and patchouli with vanilla gives the base an earthy, gourmand edge.

perfumes.name: Angel Stellar
perfumes.description: Bergamot opens clean, pistachio gives a sweet, nutty heart, and patchouli adds earthy depth. Warm, sweet and slightly green.

perfumes.name: Al Sharqia
perfumes.description: Sweet and woody: orange and fresh pine open to rose, violet and orange blossom, then vanilla, tonka bean, cedar and agarwood.

perfumes.name: Crown of Emirates
perfumes.description: Spiced and floral: saffron, mandarin and leather open to oud, peony and lychee, resting on amber, musk and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Dahn al Oud
perfumes.description: A dark, warm oud blend: bergamot, labdanum and cloves over rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang, falling to patchouli, oud and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Gold 24K
perfumes.description: A sweet, fruity-floral: orange, apricot and lily of the valley over tonka bean, sandalwood and peony, finishing with vanilla and musk.

perfumes.name: Jardin de Moghul
perfumes.description: A bright and powdery garden: lemon, bergamot and freesia over jasmine, rose and iris, ending on vanilla, tonka bean and vetiver.

perfumes.name: Oud Turath
perfumes.description: A rose-and-oud blend: bergamot, rose and magnolia, then saffron, patchouli and geranium, resting on oud, amber and musk.

perfumes.name: Touch Maroon
perfumes.description: Fresh citrus and jasmine at the start, rose and patchouli at the centre, ending on creamy sandalwood, vanilla and white musk.

perfumes.name: Ya Ghali
perfumes.description: Deep and sweet: Bulgarian and Turkish rose with saffron, over oud, vanilla and cypriol, then caramel, benzoin and castoreum.

perfumes.name: all of me
perfumes.description: Magnolia opens soft and creamy, with rose and geranium in the heart. Sandalwood and musk close it quietly, a smooth floral that stays gentle and close to the skin.

perfumes.name: all of me intense
perfumes.description: Iris and jasmine sambac open powdery and bright, then rose, geranium and tuberose deepen the heart. Musk, vanilla and sandalwood leave a creamy, sweet and softly woody finish.

perfumes.name: For Her Intense
perfumes.description: Peach and bergamot open soft and juicy over white flowers and a clear heart of musk. Vanilla and vetiver ground it, giving a smooth, skin-like finish.

perfumes.name: For Him Bleu Noir
perfumes.description: Nutmeg and cardamom give a dry spiced opening over a musky core. Ebony and cedarwood finish it in a smooth, dark, woody way.

perfumes.name: Musc Noir
perfumes.description: Plum, musk and heliotrope sit on a base of suede. The result is powdery and fruity, with a soft smoky edge.

perfumes.name: Musc Noir Rose for Her
perfumes.description: Bergamot and pink pepper give a bright, peppery start, then musk and tuberose bloom together. Vanilla, patchouli and suede make the base warm, smooth and softly dark.

perfumes.name: Blamage
perfumes.description: White woods open pale and dry, with a leather heart that smells smoky and slightly tarry. Birch and musk close it, a dark, woody, skin-warm scent.

perfumes.name: Nudiflorum
perfumes.description: A soft floral veil lifts off a base of musk. Clean, quiet and close to the skin, it reads as warm skin more than flowers, with the musk repeating gently through to the end.

perfumes.name: Pardon
perfumes.description: Magnolia opens floral, then cinnamon, tonka bean and chocolate make a sweet, spiced heart. Sandalwood and oud ground it, giving the sweetness a smooth, dark, woody depth.

perfumes.name: Nina
perfumes.description: Lime and lemon give a tart, bright opening, with gardenia and apple adding a fruity floral heart. Musk and cedarwood leave the finish clean and lightly woody.

perfumes.name: Fan Your Flames X
perfumes.description: Rum, coconut and mastic open boozy and sweet, with tobacco and thyme in the heart. Patchouli, cedarwood and oakmoss add an earthy, herbal depth.

perfumes.name: Hold Me Closer
perfumes.description: Chamomile, hawthorn and wisteria lead softly, then frankincense and angelica add a resinous calm. Vanilla, opoponax and tonka bean make the base warm and sweet.

perfumes.name: Tero
perfumes.description: Caramel and two kinds of pepper start sweet and sharp together. Patchouli and cinnamon deepen the heart, while vetiver and amber give the base a dry, woody warmth.

perfumes.name: A
perfumes.description: Mango, coconut and pink pepper open bright and creamy, with jasmine, orchid and iris in a powdery heart. Musk, amber, patchouli, tonka bean and vanilla give a sweet, warm base.

perfumes.name: Anniversario
perfumes.description: Strawberry, blueberry, peach and saffron open sweet and fruity, then rose, jasmine and heliotrope soften the heart. Patchouli, oud, musk and vanilla give it a dark, warm base.

perfumes.name: Annone
perfumes.description: Bergamot, saffron and mango open bright and golden, followed by rose and iris in a powdery floral heart. Musk, amber, cypriol and oud give the base a resinous, smoky warmth.

perfumes.name: Auris
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, lime, yuzu and lychee open zesty and juicy, with ginger, mint, myrtle and juniper making a cool, herbal heart. Ambergris, tonka bean and cedarwood leave a smooth, woody base.

perfumes.name: Così Blu
perfumes.description: Cardamom, nutmeg and strawberry open spiced and fruity, then magnolia, rose and jasmine bloom softly. Incense, sandalwood, ambergris and musk leave a creamy, smoky finish.

perfumes.name: Dolce Passione
perfumes.description: Honey and chocolate open rich and dark, with plum, strawberry and vanilla in a sweet, fruity heart. Mushroom and tonka bean add an earthy, smooth base, giving the sweetness real depth.

perfumes.name: Donna Margherita
perfumes.description: Jasmine and tuberose open lush, with daffodil, frangipani and lily of the valley adding a creamy, green floral heart. Amber and musk soften the base into a warm, glowing finish.

perfumes.name: Il Giardino
perfumes.description: Ivy opens green and cool, with apple, pear and vetiver in a fresh, earthy heart. Leather, cedarwood, benzoin and musk give the base a dry, smooth, slightly resinous warmth.

perfumes.name: M
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant, plum, raspberry and strawberry open sweet and jammy, then lily of the valley, iris, rose and Turkish rose make a powdery floral heart. Labdanum, patchouli and ambergris finish it warm.

perfumes.name: Pantheon R
perfumes.description: Cinnamon, thyme, strawberry and rhubarb open tart and spiced, then iris, jasmine and saffron fill the heart. Balsam of Peru, incense, labdanum, oud and leather make a deep, resinous base.

perfumes.name: Raffaello
perfumes.description: Absinthe opens green and herbal, then tonka bean, pepper and pink pepper make the heart sweet and spiced. Leather, teak wood and patchouli close it dry and woody.

perfumes.name: Althaïr Exclusif
perfumes.description: Bergamot, amaretto and saffron open sweet and spiced. Cinnamon, orange blossom and cardamom bloom, then praline, vanilla and guaiac wood leave a rich, warm base.

perfumes.name: Athalia
perfumes.description: Bitter orange and incense lead into a powdery heart of iris and orange blossom, ending in warm amber, suede and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Athénaïs
perfumes.description: Neroli, bergamot and yuzu lift an airy opening. Orange blossom and jasmine bloom softly, with tonka bean, vanilla and ambroxan leaving a creamy, sweet trail.

perfumes.name: Carios
perfumes.description: Saffron and pink pepper add spark to bergamot and mandarin. Geranium, thyme and pepper follow, while cedarwood, ambroxan, vetiver and tonka bean warm the base.

perfumes.name: Cassili
perfumes.description: Red currant and rose open with a juicy sweetness. Plum, mimosa and frangipani give a powdery floral heart, ending on sandalwood, tonka bean and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Castley
perfumes.description: A peppery, bright start of bergamot and ginger. Petitgrain, Sichuan pepper and neroli add a green, floral note, resting on akigalawood, labdanum and benzoin.

perfumes.name: Delina Exclusif
perfumes.description: Turkish rose and incense carry a resinous heart, brightened by bergamot, pear and lychee. Oud, amber and vanilla sweeten and deepen the base.

perfumes.name: Delina La Rosée
perfumes.description: Lychee and pear sweeten a rose and peony heart, with bergamot at the start and a soft, warm base of musk and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Eragon
perfumes.description: Bergamot, pink pepper, cardamom and mandarin open bright and spiced. Cinnamon, davana and cypriol give an earthy heart, and leather, tonka bean, vanilla and patchouli end warm.

perfumes.name: Greenley
perfumes.description: Bergamot, mandarin and crisp apple stay bright over a smooth, ambery base of cedarwood. Fresh and sunlit, with a gentle warmth underneath.

perfumes.name: Meliora
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant, raspberry and lemon spark over rose and ylang-ylang, then melt into a sweet base of vanilla, musk and praline.

perfumes.name: Oriana
perfumes.description: Mandarin, lemon and grapefruit open sparkling. Orange blossom, jasmine and chantilly cream turn sweet, and marshmallow, praline, ambroxan and musk give a soft, sugary end.

perfumes.name: Palatine
perfumes.description: Mandarin and pear start crisp and clean, moving through violet and jasmine toward a dry base of sandalwood and musk.

perfumes.name: Safanad
perfumes.description: Creamy ylang-ylang, orange blossom and jasmine glow beneath bright orange and pear, softened by vanilla and sandalwood at the close.

perfumes.name: Valero
perfumes.description: Bergamot, cedrat and juniper open sharp and green. Geranium, lavender, cypress and nutmeg follow, and patchouli, sandalwood and ambroxan finish dry and clean.

perfumes.name: Changing Constance
perfumes.description: Spicy-sweet and smoky: cardamom, salted caramel and tobacco.

perfumes.name: Changing Constance Intense
perfumes.description: A stronger, spicier take: saffron, pimento and salted caramel.

perfumes.name: Empressa
perfumes.description: Soft peach with bergamot, deepened by patchouli.

perfumes.name: Fortuitous Finley
perfumes.description: Green and leathery with a creamy twist: pistachio, violet leaf and leather.

perfumes.name: Halfeti
perfumes.description: A rich oriental built on saffron, cardamom, cinnamon and rose, opening with grapefruit and bergamot. Leather, oud, amber and vanilla give a deep, resinous, smoky base.

perfumes.name: The Blazing Mr Sam
perfumes.description: Cardamom opens bright, and cinnamon and pepper turn up the heat in the heart. Cedarwood, patchouli and tobacco form a dry, earthy, warm base.

perfumes.name: The Coveted Duchess Rose Intense
perfumes.description: A deeper, sweeter rose: vanilla, rose and amber.

perfumes.name: The Favourite
perfumes.description: Green, soft and powdery: violet leaf, mimosa and musk.

perfumes.name: The Manoeuvres of the Baroness
perfumes.description: Creamy and floral: orange blossom, chantilly and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: The Tragedy of Lord George
perfumes.description: Lavender and rum open aromatic and boozy, with tonka bean making the heart sweet and smooth. Ambroxan, vetiver and cedarwood dry the finish into something warm and woody.

perfumes.name: Missing Person
perfumes.description: Musk, bergamot and jasmine lead to cyclamen, neroli and orange blossom. Sandalwood and pale woods leave a clean, skin-close warmth.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Skin
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, apple and sugar brighten a heart of lily, jasmine and cashmere wood. Benzoin, vanilla, sandalwood and a little oud finish it.

perfumes.name: Amber
perfumes.description: Mimosa, bitter orange, mandarin and bergamot open sunny. Rose and patchouli bring an earthy floral heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, sandalwood and benzoin leave a sweet, soft base.

perfumes.name: Candy
perfumes.description: Musk, benzoin and caramel: sweet, resinous and snug. A warm gourmand that stays soft and close.

perfumes.name: Candy Gloss
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant and cherry open juicy, orange blossom and peach add a fruity floral heart, and heliotrope, musk and benzoin leave a powdery, resinous finish.

perfumes.name: La Femme Intense
perfumes.description: Tuberose and ylang-ylang make a lush, creamy floral, deepened by earthy patchouli. Dense, flowery and dark at the edges.

perfumes.name: Les Infusions Iris
perfumes.description: Iris, mandarin and neroli open fresh and clean. Cedarwood, vetiver and galbanum add a green, woody structure, while incense and benzoin soften the base.

perfumes.name: Les Infusions Mandarine
perfumes.description: Bitter orange and a touch of mandarin start bright, orange blossom and neroli bring a floral heart, and opoponax adds a creamy, resinous finish.

perfumes.name: Luna Rossa
perfumes.description: Bitter orange and lavender open fresh and herbal. Clary sage and mint cool the heart, and ambrette and ambroxan leave a clean, amber-tinged base.

perfumes.name: Luna Rossa Sport
perfumes.description: Ginger and juniper open sharp and fresh. Tonka bean and vanilla add a sweet warmth, with lavender running through for an aromatic edge.

perfumes.name: Olfactories Cargo de Nuit
perfumes.description: Musk and aldehydes begin airy, woody notes and a mineral accord add a salty dryness, and coumarin with ambroxan leaves a powdery, warm trail.

perfumes.name: Olfactories Nue Au Soleil
perfumes.description: Orange blossom and neroli give a creamy, sunlit floral, resting on patchouli and musk. Soft, skin-warm and slightly earthy.

perfumes.name: Olfactories Purple Rain
perfumes.description: Iris, orange blossom and vetiver make a powdery, creamy floral with an earthy backbone. Quiet and soft, with a cool, dry edge.

perfumes.name: Paradoxe Intense
perfumes.description: Bergamot, neroli and pear open bright, jasmine and oakmoss add a green floral depth, and amber, vanilla and musk make the base creamy and warm.

perfumes.name: Paradoxe Sweet Chemistry
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant opens fruity and tart, orange blossom brings a creamy floral sweetness, and neroli keeps it light.

perfumes.name: Paradoxe Virtual Flower
perfumes.description: Bergamot lights the way to a clean jasmine heart, resting on a bed of musk. Creamy, airy and floral, with very little clutter.

perfumes.name: 1 Million Lucky
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, sea notes and plum open fresh and juicy. Jasmine, cashmere wood, hazelnut and honey add sweet warmth, and patchouli, vetiver and oakmoss ground the end.

perfumes.name: 1 Million Privé
perfumes.description: Mandarin, cinnamon and apple open warm and bright. Tobacco and myrrh make a smoky, resinous heart, and patchouli with tonka bean leaves a sweet, earthy base.

perfumes.name: 1 Million
perfumes.description: Mint and mandarin start cool, then cinnamon and rose bring heat and sweetness. A base of leather and Amberketal makes it warm and spicy.

perfumes.name: Fame in Love
perfumes.description: Mandarin, strawberry and basil open fruity and fresh. Incense, iris and jasmine create a powdery heart, and a mineral accord, vanilla and patchouli complete the base.

perfumes.name: Fame Parfum
perfumes.description: Incense opens with a faint smoke, musk brings a clean softness, and jasmine adds a gentle floral glow. Resinous, smooth and quiet.

perfumes.name: Invictus Legend
perfumes.description: Grapefruit and sea notes open salty and crisp, laurel leaf and geranium add an herbal heart, and guaiac wood with amber leaves a warm, smoky base.

perfumes.name: Invictus Platinum
perfumes.description: Grapefruit opens sharp, lavender and oakmoss create an herbal, mossy heart, and mint and patchouli add a cool, earthy finish.

perfumes.name: Invictus
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, sea notes and mandarin start bright and salty. Bay and jasmine form the heart, and guaiac wood, oakmoss, patchouli and ambergris leave a mossy, earthy base.

perfumes.name: Invictus Victory Elixir
perfumes.description: Lavandin, cardamom and pepper open aromatic and spiced. Incense and patchouli bring an earthy, smoky heart, and vanilla and tonka bean end sweet and warm.

perfumes.name: Lady Million Empire
perfumes.description: Orange, neroli and red currant open juicy. Magnolia, orange blossom, osmanthus and plum create a lush floral heart, and cognac, patchouli and musk add a warm, boozy depth.

perfumes.name: Lady Million Fabulous
perfumes.description: Mandarin, pink pepper and sea notes open bright. Jasmine, tuberose and ylang-ylang bloom creamily, and vanilla, oakmoss and tonka bean leave a sweet, mossy finish.

perfumes.name: Lady Million Privé
perfumes.description: Orange blossom opens soft over woody notes, heliotrope and raspberry sweeten the heart, and chocolate, honey and patchouli leave a rich, powdery base.

perfumes.name: Million Gold For Her Le Parfum
perfumes.description: Ylang-ylang, jasmine and sandalwood in a simple, creamy line. The flowers are rich but soft, and the wood keeps things smooth.

perfumes.name: Phantom in Red
perfumes.description: Plum, saffron and bergamot open fruity and spiced. Lavender, sage and orange blossom shape the heart, and amberwood, benzoin, tobacco and oud give a resinous, warm base.

perfumes.name: Phantom Parfum
perfumes.description: Vetiver and lavender run side by side, one earthy and one aromatic, with vanilla adding a sweet softness. Herbal, fresh and smooth.

perfumes.name: Pure Xs for Her
perfumes.description: Ylang-ylang and vanilla open sweet and floral, popcorn and ambrette add a toasty, musky heart, and vanilla returns with sandalwood for a warm, soft base.

perfumes.name: Beyond Romance
perfumes.description: Raspberry, mandarin and bergamot open sparkling, followed by rose, jasmine and lily of the valley. Vanilla, cashmeran and musk soften the base into something fresh and floral.

perfumes.name: Romance
perfumes.description: Mandarin, pink pepper and violet leaf open bright and slightly peppery, then rose, jasmine and marigold bloom in the heart. Patchouli, oakmoss and musk lend an earthy, powdery finish.

perfumes.name: Elixir
perfumes.description: Bergamot and artemisia give a green, aromatic start. Lavender and benzoin follow, drying into a smooth base of vanilla and tonka bean.

perfumes.name: Pacific Aura
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant, lemon and mint sparkle over apricot, basil and rose, before dates, fig and ambrette add a mellow, sunny sweetness.

perfumes.name: Nude
perfumes.description: Guava, mandarin and pear brighten a creamy bouquet of orange blossom, jasmine sambac and gardenia, which settles into sandalwood, orchid and musk.

perfumes.name: Fiamma
perfumes.description: Pear opens soft and juicy, and gardenia glows at the heart, touched with spice. Amber closes it warm, a floral that turns slowly from fruit to a golden, spiced base.

perfumes.name: Feminite Du Bois
perfumes.description: Cedarwood wrapped in spice and sweetness: honey, cinnamon, clove and cardamom, with plum, peach and violet in the heart. Sandalwood, benzoin, vanilla and musk keep it warm, dense and lingering.

perfumes.name: La Fille de Berlin
perfumes.description: Rose and geranium open bold and floral, with palmarosa giving a green, bright edge. Patchouli, honey and oakmoss darken the base, sweet and earthy in equal measure.

perfumes.name: Il Padrino
perfumes.description: Amaretto, blackcurrant, rum and bergamot open sweet and boozy, with amber, patchouli and sandalwood in the heart. Labdanum, vanilla and benzoin leave a rich, resinous glow.

perfumes.name: Crying of Evil
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, tuberose, violet and spice open rich and floral, with sandalwood, leather and rose in the heart. Patchouli, amber, frankincense and musk make a dark, resinous base.

perfumes.name: God of Fire
perfumes.description: Mango, lemon, pink pepper and ginger open bright and fruity, then coumarin, jasmine and dry wood warm the heart. Oud, cypriol, musk and amber give it a smoky, spiced base.

perfumes.name: Lady White Snake
perfumes.description: Mandarin, orange blossom and honeysuckle open sweet and bright, with magnolia, tuberose and jasmine in a creamy heart. Amber, leather and musk give the base a smoky, soft warmth.

perfumes.name: Wonderstruck
perfumes.description: Freesia, blackberry, raspberry and apple blossom make a bright berry-floral start. Vanilla and honeysuckle follow, softening into musk, sandalwood and peach.

perfumes.name: Halley
perfumes.description: Passion fruit, blackcurrant and rose open juicy and bright, with a long floral heart of iris, tuberose and peach. Vanilla, oud and cedarwood end warm.

perfumes.name: Orza
perfumes.description: Apple, plum and coconut lead into jasmine, rose and lily of the valley. Sandalwood, vanilla and caramel make the finish creamy, sweet and softly floral.

perfumes.name: Porpora
perfumes.description: Rose and raspberry begin with a hint of cinnamon, and incense gives the heart a smoky edge. Benzoin, myrrh and amber leave a resinous, warm base.

perfumes.name: Black Lacquer
perfumes.description: A glossy ink-dark opening leads to ebony wood and a smoky, resinous frankincense base. Quiet, dense and woody, with a warm finish.

perfumes.name: Black Orchid Reserve
perfumes.description: Bergamot and an earthy touch of mushroom introduce orchid and ylang-ylang. Chocolate, patchouli, tonka bean and vanilla make the base sweet, dark and rounded.

perfumes.name: Bois Pacifique
perfumes.description: Turmeric adds a dry, golden spice at the top, leaving sandalwood and oakwood to take over. Woody, warm and quiet.

perfumes.name: Eau de Soleil Blanc
perfumes.description: Sun-warmed bergamot over creamy ylang-ylang, finishing on coco de mer. Soft, floral and lightly sweet, like skin after a day outdoors.

perfumes.name: Fougère D'Argent
perfumes.description: Mandarin, lavender and ginger lead into labdanum and akigalawood. Coumarin rounds it off with a warm, sweet, woody softness.

perfumes.name: Grey Vetiver
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, orange blossom and sage open sharp, then nutmeg, iris and pimento add a powdery spice. Vetiver, amber and oakmoss ground it in earthy warmth.

perfumes.name: Jasmin Rouge
perfumes.description: Bergamot, mandarin and a quartet of spices open warm. Jasmine sambac and ylang-ylang bloom in the heart, then vanilla, labdanum, leather and amber give a creamy, resinous finish.

perfumes.name: Mandarino di Amalfi
perfumes.description: A garden of citrus and herbs: tarragon, mint, basil, grapefruit and lemon over orange blossom and jasmine. Vetiver, amber and musk quietly hold the base.

perfumes.name: Myrrhe Mystère
perfumes.description: Sandalwood and myrrh trade places from opening to heart, then rest on Ultravanil, amber, vetiver and cedarwood. A warm, resinous, quietly sweet scent.

perfumes.name: Neroli Portofino Parfum
perfumes.description: Neroli threads through every stage, from blood orange and lemon to clary sage and jasmine sambac. Musk and amber give it a creamy, clean landing.

perfumes.name: Noir Extreme
perfumes.description: Mandarin, saffron and cardamom open spiced and glowing. Orange blossom and jasmine soften the heart, while vanilla, sandalwood and amber give a rich, creamy base.

perfumes.name: Oud Minérale
perfumes.description: Sea notes meet oud in a salty, resinous blend, finished with ambergris. Mineral and rich, it smells like warm rock beside cool water.

perfumes.name: Oud Voyager
perfumes.description: Geranium and peony soften the start, then osmanthus meets oud, which carries through to a base of cypriol. Floral, earthy and richly resinous.

perfumes.name: Santal Blush
perfumes.description: Sandalwood sits creamy and smooth, with cinnamon adding a gentle spice and ylang-ylang a soft floral lift. Warm, rounded and subtle.

perfumes.name: Soleil de Feu
perfumes.description: Tuberose, sandalwood and benzoin, just three notes. Creamy white flower meets a smooth woody resin that feels sunlit and rich.

perfumes.name: Taormina Orange
perfumes.description: Blood orange and bitter orange stay juicy and sharp, while oakmoss adds an earthy, shaded finish. Clean citrus with a bit of grit.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Sex
perfumes.description: Almond opens into layers of vanilla, tonka bean and Ultravanil, with floral notes and sandalwood behind them. Sweet, warm and smooth.

perfumes.name: Velvet Orchid
perfumes.description: Bergamot, mandarin and honey open the door to a thick floral heart of jasmine, rose, orchid and magnolia. Suede, myrrh and sandalwood finish plush and resinous.

perfumes.name: White Suede
perfumes.description: Tea and thyme open crisply, then rose, lily of the valley and saffron lead into suede, musk, amber and sandalwood. Soft, floral and faintly spiced.

perfumes.name: Behind the Curtain Piazza alla Scala
perfumes.description: Warm, spiced woods: bergamot, saffron and clove over jasmine, labdanum and juniper, ending on cedar, sandalwood and patchouli.

perfumes.name: District of Nolo
perfumes.description: Fresh and fruity-floral: lemon, pear and violet leaf, iris and rose at the heart, and a base of musk and vanilla.

perfumes.name: I Vicoli Via Fiori Chiari
perfumes.description: Warm and spicy with sweetness: anise, cardamom and lemon over pepper and patchouli, ending on vanilla and a liqueur accord.

perfumes.name: Limitless Shopping Via della Spiga
perfumes.description: A sweet floral with honey: bergamot, apple and honey over rose and jasmine, resting on heliotrope, tonka bean and musk.

perfumes.name: Musc Noir Perfume Enhancer
perfumes.description: A musky-floral blend: iris and lime open to jasmine, resting on cedarwood and musk.

perfumes.name: My Name
perfumes.description: Violet and heliotrope open powdery and sweet, with lilac, musk and lily in the heart. Amber and vanilla give the base a warm, enveloping softness.

perfumes.name: Primo
perfumes.description: Grapefruit and maple make a bright, slightly sweet opening, with geranium and pimento adding floral spice. Patchouli and wood ground the base, warm and earthy.

perfumes.name: Ruby Red
perfumes.description: Bergamot, red fruits and ginger open juicy and bright, then cinnamon, ylang-ylang and vanilla make the heart warm and sweet. Sandalwood and patchouli ground it, smooth and spiced.

perfumes.name: The Italian Artists of Via Solferino
perfumes.description: Mineral and tea-like at the start, with magnolia, ginger and peony in the centre, resting on heliotrope, patchouli and suede.

perfumes.name: The Street Artists of Isola
perfumes.description: Airy and musky: ambrette, water lily and cyclamen over fennel and iris, closing on musk and white woods.

perfumes.name: Trussardi Black Extreme
perfumes.description: Green and powdery with a dark base: lemon, galbanum and cypress over iris, plum and violet, then patchouli, vetiver and leather.

perfumes.name: Trussardi Elegantly Cool
perfumes.description: Soft and creamy: sesame, neroli and grapefruit lead to mimosa, ylang-ylang and jasmine, finishing on musk, tonka bean and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Trussardi Pure Jasmine
perfumes.description: A creamy jasmine: bergamot, pistachio and neroli open to champaca and jasmine, resting on patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Trussardi Uomo
perfumes.description: A classic fresh masculine: lemon, bergamot and nutmeg, clary sage, geranium and violet over patchouli, musk and leather.

perfumes.name: Walking in Porta Venezia
perfumes.description: Aromatic and warm: anise, lemon and pepper over violet, absinthe and geranium, ending on patchouli, vanilla and cedar.

perfumes.name: Walking on Via Fiori Oscuri
perfumes.description: A powdery, sweet floral: mandarin and bergamot, mimosa, magnolia and rose, resting on rice powder, tonka bean and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Born in Roma Purple Melancholia
perfumes.description: Plum, osmanthus and vanilla are the whole story here. The fruit is dark and sweet, the flower soft, and the vanilla lingers warm.

perfumes.name: Born In Roma Uomo
perfumes.description: Violet leaf and vetiver open green, salt and sage add a mineral, herbal note, and wood and ginger leave a dry, spiced finish.

perfumes.name: Donna
perfumes.description: Rose and iris form the heart, lit by bergamot and saffron. Leather, patchouli and vanilla give a powdery, warm base.

perfumes.name: Donna Born in Roma Coral Fantasy
perfumes.description: Orange opens sunny, jasmine and rose bloom softly, and ambrette with musk leaves a clean, skin-close finish.

perfumes.name: Donna Born in Roma Green Stravaganza
perfumes.description: Smoked tea hangs over jasmine and vanilla, giving a creamy floral a faint trail of smoke. Sweet, soft and slightly unexpected.

perfumes.name: Donna Born in Roma Intense
perfumes.description: Jasmine in a sweet cloud of vanilla, held warm by resinous benzoin. A soft floral with a creamy, amber-like finish.

perfumes.name: Donna Born in Roma Yellow Dream
perfumes.description: Juicy lychee, bergamot and lemon open bright. Peony and Turkish rose follow, and musk, vanilla and cedarwood keep it soft and clean.

perfumes.name: Uomo Born in Roma Coral Fantasy
perfumes.description: Apple and bergamot open juicy, sage and geranium add an herbal heart, and vanilla, tobacco and patchouli make a sweet, earthy base.

perfumes.name: Uomo Born in Roma Green Stravaganza
perfumes.description: Bergamot gives a bright lift before a sweet, roasted coffee heart. Vetiver adds an earthy, green warmth underneath.

perfumes.name: Uomo Born in Roma Yellow Dream
perfumes.description: Pineapple, lime and mandarin open bright and sweet. Lavender, geranium and gingerbread add warm spice, and vanilla, amber and cedarwood end smooth.

perfumes.name: Uomo
perfumes.description: Bergamot opens clean, then coffee, hazelnut and chocolate create a sweet, roasted heart. Leather and cedarwood add a dry, woody base.

perfumes.name: Valentina
perfumes.description: Strawberry and bergamot open fruity. Jasmine and patchouli add a floral, earthy heart, and cedarwood with vanilla leaves a sweet, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Valentino Voce Viva Intensa
perfumes.description: Bergamot and orange blossom open a heart of jasmine sambac and more orange blossom. Vanilla and oakmoss round it into a creamy, sweet floral.

perfumes.name: Vendetta Uomo
perfumes.description: Ginger, cinnamon and patchouli form a simple, spiced line. Warm and earthy, it moves from a bright bite to a deep, dark finish.

perfumes.name: Bright Crystal Absolu
perfumes.description: Yuzu and pomegranate sparkle first. Raspberry, lotus, peony and magnolia form a juicy floral heart that dries down to mahogany, musk and amber.

perfumes.name: Dylan Blue Pour Homme
perfumes.description: Aquatic accord, fig, bergamot and grapefruit open fresh. Violet leaf, patchouli, papyrus and pepper follow, and musk, tonka bean, saffron and frankincense add warm depth.

perfumes.name: Eros Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Lemon, mandarin, mint and apple open cool and green. Geranium and clary sage add a herbal heart, and cedarwood, vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla make a woody, sweet base.

perfumes.name: Eros Eau de Toilette
perfumes.description: Mint, lemon and apple open crisp. Tonka bean and geranium add sweetness, and vanilla, vetiver, cedarwood and oakmoss leave a warm, mossy finish.

perfumes.name: Eros Najim
perfumes.description: Mandarin, clary sage, saffron and cardamom open golden. Oud, cedarwood and caramel create a sweet, resinous heart, and patchouli, vetiver, incense and tonka bean end deep and warm.

perfumes.name: Eros Parfum
perfumes.description: Lemon, mandarin and pepper open fresh and bright. Geranium, clary sage and lavender shape the heart, and cashmeran, benzoin, vetiver, patchouli and vanilla add a sweet, woody base.

perfumes.name: Man Eau Fraiche
perfumes.description: Lemon, rose and carambola open bright and juicy. Tarragon, clary sage and cedarwood create an herbal, woody heart, and sycamore wood, amber and musk end clean.

perfumes.name: Red Jeans
perfumes.description: Freesia, red currant and water lily open light and watery. Peony, gardenia and violet follow, drying into a creamy base of musk, sandalwood and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Dreamer
perfumes.description: Juniper, artemisia and tarragon open green and herbal. Iris and amber lily bring a powdery floral softness, and tobacco flower with amber leaves a warm finish.

perfumes.name: Mango Skin
perfumes.description: Blackberry, mango and pepper open juicy with a hint of spice, then iris, lotus and jasmine soften the heart. Patchouli, vanilla and sugar make the base warm and sweet.

perfumes.name: Morning Chess
perfumes.description: Bergamot opens bright, and leather and galbanum give the heart a green, smoky edge. Patchouli and amber close it earthy and warm, a fresh start that settles into dry leather.

perfumes.name: Smoke Show
perfumes.description: Pink pepper and saffron open warm and spiced, with rose and leather sharing a smoky heart. Vetiver, cedarwood and oud close it dry and dark, floral at the edges.

perfumes.name: Black II
perfumes.description: Plum and mandarin open fruity and bright, then rose, sandalwood and musk make a soft, floral heart. Vanilla and oakmoss give the base a creamy, mossy warmth.

perfumes.name: London
perfumes.description: Oud, violet and cypress open dark and green, with raspberry and lily of the valley adding a fruity, floral heart. Leather, vanilla, amber and musk close it warm and smooth.

perfumes.name: New York
perfumes.description: Citrus, lavender and juniper open into geranium, iris and caramel, then deepen with vetiver, vanilla, amber and tobacco in a warm, sweet base.

perfumes.name: Black Opium Intense
perfumes.description: Absinthe and liquorice open on a sweet, dark note, then jasmine sambac and orange blossom bloom. Vanilla, sandalwood and coffee build a rich, creamy base.

perfumes.name: Black Opium Le Parfum
perfumes.description: Coffee and vanilla form a warm, sweet base beneath a veil of floral notes. Dark, cosy and gourmand, with a soft flowery glow.

perfumes.name: Black Opium Pink Glaze
perfumes.description: Mandarin, strawberry and bergamot give a candied, bright start before jasmine and orange blossom. Amber, coffee, patchouli, vanilla and resins close it warm and sweet.

perfumes.name: Kouros
perfumes.description: A complex classic: aldehydes, absinthe and sage open sharp, carnation and iris add a powdery floral heart, and honey, leather, civet and amber leave an animalic warmth.

perfumes.name: Libre Berry Crush
perfumes.description: Juicy raspberry and creamy coconut meet orange blossom and lavender, resting on soft vanilla. Sweet and fruity, with a herbal thread running through.

perfumes.name: Libre Eau de Toilette
perfumes.description: Bergamot, mandarin and lavender give a fresh, clear start. Orange blossom, jasmine and tea follow, finishing on a soft blend of musk, vanilla and ambergris.

perfumes.name: Libre Intense
perfumes.description: Lavender and orange blossom open into jasmine sambac and orchid, then tonka bean, vanilla and ambergris with a dry vetiver edge. Creamy, floral and warm.

perfumes.name: Libre Le Parfum
perfumes.description: Mandarin, ginger and saffron start bright and a little spicy. Bergamot, orange blossom and lavender follow, settling on honeyed vanilla and dry vetiver.

perfumes.name: Libre Vanille Couture
perfumes.description: Blackcurrant, lavender and mandarin lead into a heart of jasmine and orange blossom. Vanilla, amber, cedarwood and musk give it a creamy, polished finish.

perfumes.name: Mon Paris Intensément
perfumes.description: Juicy blackcurrant, raspberry and pear open the way to rose, peony and freesia. Musk, patchouli and benzoin keep it soft and slightly sweet.

perfumes.name: Muse
perfumes.description: Iris, vanilla and black ink: powdery, sweet and faintly smoky. It wraps the skin in warmth with a dark, papery edge.

perfumes.name: MYSLF Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Doubled bergamot meets orange blossom in a clean, floral heart, resting on wood, patchouli and a soft Ambrofix glow. Fresh and sunlit.

perfumes.name: Myslf Intense
perfumes.description: Bergamot lifts a heart of orange blossom and wood, finished with a smooth musk. Clean, floral and woody, with a citrus freshness at the top.

perfumes.name: Paris
perfumes.description: A soft, powdery floral built on rose, violet and lily, with mimosa and green leaves up top. Sandalwood, iris, oakmoss and musk give it a gentle, creamy finish.

perfumes.name: Y Eau de Parfum
perfumes.description: Apple, juniper and sage sit under a sparkle of bergamot and ginger. Vetiver and frankincense hold the base, keeping the whole thing fresh, green and a little smoky.

perfumes.name: Y Eau de Toilette
perfumes.description: Geranium and lavender lead in a clean, herbal way, with incense giving a faint resinous glow. Fresh, floral and softly smoky.

perfumes.name: Y Le Parfum
perfumes.description: Ginger and bergamot give a sharp, bright start. Pine and fir balsam add a green, resinous chill before amber and patchouli warm the base.
